18216.text: The land has been polluted by its inhabitants, For they have bypassed the laws, Changed the regulation, And broken the lasting covenant.

18217.label: Isaiah 24:6
18217.text: That is why the curse devours the land, And those inhabiting it are held guilty. That is why the inhabitants of the land have dwindled,And very few men are left.

18218.label: Isaiah 24:7
18218.text: The new wine mourns, the vine withers, And all those cheerful at heart are sighing.

18219.label: Isaiah 24:8
18219.text: The joy of the tambourines has ceased;The noise of the revelers has ended;The happy sound of the harp has ceased.

18220.label: Isaiah 24:9
18220.text: They drink wine without song,And alcohol tastes bitter to those drinking it.

18221.label: Isaiah 24:10
18221.text: The deserted town is broken down; Every house is shut up so that no one can enter.

18222.label: Isaiah 24:11
18222.text: They cry out for wine in the streets. All rejoicing has disappeared;The joy of the land has gone.

18223.label: Isaiah 24:12
18223.text: The city is left in ruins;The gate has been crushed to a heap of rubble.

18224.label: Isaiah 24:13
18224.text: For this is how it will be in the land, among the peoples: As when an olive tree is beaten, Like the gleaning when the grape harvest comes to an end.

18225.label: Isaiah 24:14
18225.text: They will raise their voice,They will shout joyfully. From the sea they will proclaim the majesty of Jehovah.

18226.label: Isaiah 24:15
18226.text: That is why they will glorify Jehovah in the region of light; In the islands of the sea they will glorify the name of Jehovah the God of Israel.

18227.label: Isaiah 24:16
18227.text: From the ends of the earth we hear songs: “Glory to the Righteous One!” But I say: “I am wasting away, I am wasting away! Woe to me! The treacherous have acted treacherously;With treachery the treacherous have acted treacherously.”

18228.label: Isaiah 24:17
18228.text: Terror and pits and traps await you, inhabitant of the land.

18229.label: Isaiah 24:18
18229.text: Anyone fleeing from the sound of terror will fall into the pit,And anyone coming up from the pit will be caught in the trap. For the floodgates above will be opened,And the foundations of the land will quake.

18230.label: Isaiah 24:19
18230.text: The land has burst apart;The land has been shaken up;The land convulses violently.

18231.label: Isaiah 24:20
18231.text: The land staggers like a drunken man,And it sways back and forth like a hut in the wind. Its transgression weighs heavily on it, And it will fall, so that it will not rise up again.

18232.label: Isaiah 24:21
18232.text: In that day Jehovah will turn his attention to the army of the heights aboveAnd to the kings of the earth upon the earth.

18233.label: Isaiah 24:22
18233.text: And they will be gathered togetherLike prisoners gathered into a pit,And they will be shut up in the dungeon;After many days they will be given attention.

18234.label: Isaiah 24:23
18234.text: The full moon will be abashed,And the shining sun will be ashamed, For Jehovah of armies has become King in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem,Glorious before the elders of his people.

18235.label: Isaiah 25:1
18235.text: O Jehovah, you are my God. I exalt you, I praise your name,For you have done wonderful things, Things purposed from ancient times, In faithfulness, in trustworthiness.

18236.label: Isaiah 25:2
18236.text: For you have turned a city into a pile of stones,A fortified town into a crumbling ruin. The foreigner’s tower is a city no more;It will never be rebuilt.

18237.label: Isaiah 25:3
18237.text: That is why a strong people will glorify you;The city of tyrannical nations will fear you.

18238.label: Isaiah 25:4
18238.text: For you have become a stronghold to the lowly,A stronghold to the poor in his distress, A refuge from the rainstorm,And a shade from the heat. When the blast of the tyrants is like a rainstorm against a wall,

18239.label: Isaiah 25:5
18239.text: As the heat in a parched land,You subdue the uproar of strangers. Like heat that is subdued by the shadow of a cloud,So the song of the tyrants is silenced.

18240.label: Isaiah 25:6
18240.text: In this mountain Jehovah of armies will make for all the peoplesA banquet of rich dishes, A banquet of fine wine, Of rich dishes filled with marrow,Of fine, filtered wine.

18241.label: Isaiah 25:7
18241.text: In this mountain he will do away with the shroud that is enveloping all the peoplesAnd the covering that is woven over all the nations.

18242.label: Isaiah 25:8
18242.text: He will swallow up death forever, And the Sovereign Lord Jehovah will wipe away the tears from all faces. The reproach of his people he will take away from all the earth,For Jehovah himself has spoken it.

18243.label: Isaiah 25:9
18243.text: In that day they will say: “Look! This is our God! We have hoped in him, And he will save us. This is Jehovah! We have hoped in him. Let us be joyful and rejoice in the salvation by him.”

18244.label: Isaiah 25:10
18244.text: For the hand of Jehovah will rest on this mountain, And Moʹab will be trampled on in its place Like straw trampled into a pile of manure.

18245.label: Isaiah 25:11
18245.text: He will slap out his hands into itLike a swimmer slapping out his hands to swim,And he will bring down its haughtiness With the skillful movements of his hands.

18246.label: Isaiah 25:12
18246.text: And the fortified city, with your high walls of security,He will bring down;He will knock it down to the ground, to the very dust.

18247.label: Isaiah 26:1
18247.text: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. He makes salvation its walls and its ramparts.

18248.label: Isaiah 26:2
18248.text: Open up the gates so that the righteous nation may enter,A nation that is keeping faithful conduct.

18249.label: Isaiah 26:3
18249.text: You will safeguard those who fully lean on you; You will give them continuous peace, Because it is in you that they trust.

18250.label: Isaiah 26:4
18250.text: Trust in Jehovah forever, For Jah Jehovah is the eternal Rock.

18251.label: Isaiah 26:5
18251.text: For he has brought low those inhabiting the height, the lofty city. He brings it down,He brings it down to the earth;He casts it down to the dust.

18252.label: Isaiah 26:6
18252.text: The foot will trample it,The feet of the afflicted, the steps of the lowly.”

18253.label: Isaiah 26:7
18253.text: The path of the righteous one is upright. Because you are upright,You will smooth out the course of the righteous.

18254.label: Isaiah 26:8
18254.text: As we follow the path of your judgments, O Jehovah,Our hope is in you. We long for your name and your memorial.

18255.label: Isaiah 26:9
18255.text: In the night I long for you with my whole being, Yes, my spirit keeps looking for you; For when there are judgments from you for the earth,The inhabitants of the land learn about righteousness.

18256.label: Isaiah 26:10
18256.text: Even if the wicked is shown favor,He will not learn righteousness. Even in the land of uprightness he will act wickedly, And he will not see the majesty of Jehovah.

18257.label: Isaiah 26:11
18257.text: O Jehovah, your hand is raised, but they do not see it. They will see your zeal for your people and be put to shame. Yes, the fire for your adversaries will consume them.

18258.label: Isaiah 26:12
18258.text: O Jehovah, you will grant us peace, Because everything we have doneYou have accomplished for us.

18259.label: Isaiah 26:13
18259.text: O Jehovah our God, other masters besides you have ruled over us, But we make mention of your name alone.

18260.label: Isaiah 26:14
18260.text: They are dead; they will not live. Powerless in death, they will not rise up. For you have turned your attention to themTo annihilate them and destroy all mention of them.

18261.label: Isaiah 26:15
18261.text: You have enlarged the nation, O Jehovah,You have enlarged the nation;You have glorified yourself. You have greatly extended all the borders of the land.

18262.label: Isaiah 26:16
18262.text: O Jehovah, during distress they turned to you;They poured out their prayer in a whisper when you disciplined them.

18263.label: Isaiah 26:17
18263.text: Just as a pregnant woman about to give birthHas labor pains and cries out in pain,So we have been because of you, O Jehovah.

18264.label: Isaiah 26:18
18264.text: We became pregnant, we had labor pains,But it is as if we had given birth to wind. We have not brought salvation to the land,And no one is born to inhabit the land.

18265.label: Isaiah 26:19
18265.text: “Your dead will live. My corpses will rise up. Awake and shout joyfully,You residents in the dust! For your dew is as the dew of the morning, And the earth will let those powerless in death come to life.

18266.label: Isaiah 26:20
18266.text: Go, my people, enter your inner rooms,And shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a brief momentUntil the wrath has passed by.

18267.label: Isaiah 26:21
18267.text: For look! Jehovah is coming from his placeTo call the inhabitants of the land to account for their error,And the land will expose her bloodshedAnd will no longer cover over her slain.”

18268.label: Isaiah 27:1
18268.text: In that day Jehovah, with his harsh and great and strong sword, Will turn his attention to Le·viʹa·than, the gliding serpent,To Le·viʹa·than, the twisting serpent,And he will kill the monster that is in the sea.

18269.label: Isaiah 27:2
18269.text: In that day sing to her: “A vineyard of foaming wine!

18270.label: Isaiah 27:3
18270.text: I, Jehovah, am safeguarding her. Every moment I water her. I safeguard her night and day,So that no one may harm her.

18271.label: Isaiah 27:4
18271.text: There is no wrath in me. Who will confront me with thornbushes and weeds in the battle? I will trample them and set them on fire all together.

18272.label: Isaiah 27:5
18272.text: Otherwise, let him hold fast to my stronghold. Let him make peace with me;Peace let him make with me.”

18273.label: Isaiah 27:6
18273.text: In the coming days Jacob will take root,Israel will blossom and sprout, And they will fill the land with produce.

18274.label: Isaiah 27:7
18274.text: Must he be struck with the stroke of the one striking him? Or must he be killed as with the slaughter of his slain?

18275.label: Isaiah 27:8
18275.text: With a startling cry you will contend with her when sending her away. He will expel her with his fierce blast in the day of the east wind.

18276.label: Isaiah 27:9
18276.text: So in this way the error of Jacob will be atoned for, And this will be the full fruitage when his sin is taken away: He will make all the stones of the altarLike chalkstones that have been pulverized,And no sacred poles or incense stands will be left.

18277.label: Isaiah 27:10
18277.text: For the fortified city will be deserted;The pastures will be forsaken and abandoned like a wilderness. There the calf will graze and lie downAnd will consume her branches.

18278.label: Isaiah 27:11
18278.text: When her twigs have dried up,Women will come and break them off,Making fires with them. For this people is without understanding. That is why their Maker will show them no mercy,And the One who formed them will show them no favor.

18279.label: Isaiah 27:12
18279.text: In that day Jehovah will beat out the fruit from the flowing stream of the River to the Wadi of Egypt, and you will be gathered up one after the other, O people of Israel.

18280.label: Isaiah 27:13
18280.text: In that day a great horn will be blown, and those who are perishing in the land of As·syrʹi·a and those dispersed in the land of Egypt will come and bow down to Jehovah in the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

18281.label: Isaiah 28:1
18281.text: Woe to the showy crown of the drunkards of Eʹphra·im And the fading blossom of its glorious beauty,Which is on the head of the fertile valley of those overcome with wine!

18282.label: Isaiah 28:2
18282.text: Look! Jehovah has someone strong and mighty. Like a thundering hailstorm, a destructive windstorm,Like a thunderstorm of powerful floodwaters,He will forcefully hurl it down to the earth.

18283.label: Isaiah 28:3
18283.text: The showy crowns of the drunkards of Eʹphra·imWill be trampled underfoot.

18284.label: Isaiah 28:4
18284.text: And the fading flower of its glorious beauty,Which is on the head of the fertile valley,Will become like the early fig before summer. When someone sees it, he swallows it as soon as it is in his hand.

18285.label: Isaiah 28:5
18285.text: In that day Jehovah of armies will become a glorious crown and a beautiful garland to those left of his people.

18286.label: Isaiah 28:6
18286.text: And he will become a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment and a source of mightiness to those who repel the attack at the gate.

18287.label: Isaiah 28:7
18287.text: And these also go astray because of wine;Their alcoholic beverages make them stagger. Priest and prophet go astray because of alcohol;The wine confuses them,And they stagger from their alcohol;Their vision makes them go astray,And they stumble in judgment.

18288.label: Isaiah 28:8
18288.text: For their tables are full of filthy vomit—There is no place without it.

18289.label: Isaiah 28:9
18289.text: To whom will one impart knowledge,And to whom will one explain the message? To those who have just been weaned from milk,Those just taken away from the breasts?

18290.label: Isaiah 28:10
18290.text: For it is “command after command, command after command,Line by line, line by line, A little here, a little there.”

18291.label: Isaiah 28:11
18291.text: So by means of those with stammering speech and a foreign language, he will speak to this people.

18292.label: Isaiah 28:12
18292.text: He once told them: “This is the resting-place. Let the weary one rest; this is the place of refreshment,” but they refused to listen.

18293.label: Isaiah 28:13
18293.text: So to them the word of Jehovah will be: “Command after command, command after command,Line by line, line by line, A little here, a little there,” So that when they walk,They will stumble and fall backwardAnd be broken and ensnared and caught.

18294.label: Isaiah 28:14
18294.text: So hear the word of Jehovah, you boasters,You rulers of this people in Jerusalem,

18295.label: Isaiah 28:15
18295.text: For you men say: “We have made a covenant with Death, And with the Grave we have made an agreement. When the raging flash flood passes through,It will not reach us,For we have made a lie our refugeAnd we have hidden ourselves in falsehood.”

18296.label: Isaiah 28:16
18296.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Here I am laying as a foundation in Zion a tested stone, The precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. No one exercising faith will panic.

18297.label: Isaiah 28:17
18297.text: And I will make justice the measuring line And righteousness the leveling tool. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies,And the waters will flood out the hiding place.

18298.label: Isaiah 28:18
18298.text: Your covenant with Death will be dissolved,And your agreement with the Grave will not stand. When the raging flash flood passes through,You will be crushed by it.

18299.label: Isaiah 28:19
18299.text: As often as it passes through,It will sweep you away; For it will pass through morning after morning,During the day and during the night. Only terror will make them understand what was heard.”

18300.label: Isaiah 28:20
18300.text: For the bed is too short to stretch out on,And the woven sheet is too narrow to wrap up in.

18301.label: Isaiah 28:21
18301.text: For Jehovah will rise up as at Mount Pe·raʹzim;He will rouse himself as in the valley near Gibʹe·on, That he may do his deed—his strange deed—And that he may carry out his work—his unusual work.

18302.label: Isaiah 28:22
18302.text: Now do not scoff, So that your bonds may not be further tightened,For I have heard from the Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies,That an extermination has been determined for all the land.

18303.label: Isaiah 28:23
18303.text: Give ear and listen to my voice;Pay attention and listen to what I say.

18304.label: Isaiah 28:24
18304.text: Does the plower keep plowing all day before he sows seed? Does he continually break up and harrow his ground?

18305.label: Isaiah 28:25
18305.text: When he has smoothed out its surface,Does he not then scatter black cumin and sow cumin,And does he not plant wheat, millet, and barley in their placesAnd spelt around the edges?

18306.label: Isaiah 28:26
18306.text: For He teaches him the right way;His God instructs him.

18307.label: Isaiah 28:27
18307.text: For black cumin is not crushed with a threshing sledge, And a wagon wheel is not driven over cumin. Rather, black cumin is beaten out with a rod,And cumin with a staff.

18308.label: Isaiah 28:28
18308.text: Does a person crush grain for bread? No, he does not thresh it incessantly; And when he drives the roller of his wagon over it with his horses,He does not crush it.

18309.label: Isaiah 28:29
18309.text: This also comes from Jehovah of armies,Whose counsel is wonderfulAnd whose achievements are great.

18310.label: Isaiah 29:1
18310.text: “Woe to Arʹi·el, Arʹi·el, the city where David encamped! Continue year after year;Let the cycle of festivals continue.

18311.label: Isaiah 29:2
18311.text: But I will bring distress on Arʹi·el, And there will be mourning and lamentation, And she will become to me like an altar hearth of God.

18312.label: Isaiah 29:3
18312.text: I will encamp on all sides against you,And I will besiege you with a palisadeAnd raise up siegeworks against you.

18313.label: Isaiah 29:4
18313.text: You will be brought low;From the ground you will speak,And what you say will be muffled by dust. Your voice will come from the ground Like the voice of a spirit medium,And your words will chirp from the dust.

18314.label: Isaiah 29:5
18314.text: The crowd of your enemies will be like fine powder, The crowd of the tyrants just like the blowing chaff. And it will happen in an instant, suddenly.

18315.label: Isaiah 29:6
18315.text: Jehovah of armies will give you his attentionWith thunder and earthquake and a great noise,With storm wind and tempest and the flames of a consuming fire.”

18316.label: Isaiah 29:7
18316.text: Then the crowd of all the nations waging war against Arʹi·el —All those waging war against her,The siege towers against her,And those bringing distress on her—Will become like a dream, a vision of the night.

18317.label: Isaiah 29:8
18317.text: Yes, it will be just as when someone hungry dreams that he is eating,But he wakes up hungry, And as when someone thirsty dreams that he is drinking,But he wakes up tired and thirsty. So it will happen with the crowd of all the nationsThat wage war against Mount Zion.

18318.label: Isaiah 29:9
18318.text: Be stunned and amazed; Blind yourselves and be blinded. They are drunk, but not with wine;They are staggering, but not from alcohol.

18319.label: Isaiah 29:10
18319.text: For Jehovah has poured a spirit of deep sleep on you; He has closed your eyes, the prophets, And he has covered your heads, the visionaries.

18320.label: Isaiah 29:11
18320.text: Every vision becomes for you like the words of a sealed book. When they give it to someone who can read, saying: “Read this out loud, please,” he will say: “I cannot, for it is sealed up.”

18321.label: Isaiah 29:12
18321.text: And when they give the book to someone who cannot read, saying: “Read this, please,” he will say: “I cannot read at all.”

18322.label: Isaiah 29:13
18322.text: Jehovah says: “This people approach me with their mouthAnd they honor me with their lips, But their heart is far removed from me;And their fear of me is based on commands of men that they have been taught.

18323.label: Isaiah 29:14
18323.text: Therefore, I am the One who will again do wonderful things with this people, With wonder upon wonder;And the wisdom of their wise men will perish,And the understanding of their discreet men will be hidden.”

18324.label: Isaiah 29:15
18324.text: Woe to those who go to great lengths to conceal their plans from Jehovah. Their deeds are done in a dark place,While they say: “Who sees us? Who knows about us?”

18325.label: Isaiah 29:16
18325.text: How you twist things! Should the potter be regarded the same as the clay? Should what is made say about its maker: “He did not make me”? And does what is formed say about its former: “He shows no understanding”?

18326.label: Isaiah 29:17
18326.text: In just a short time, Lebʹa·non will be turned into an orchard, And the orchard will be regarded as a forest.

18327.label: Isaiah 29:18
18327.text: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the book,And out of the gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.

18328.label: Isaiah 29:19
18328.text: The meek will rejoice greatly in Jehovah,And the poor among men will be joyful in the Holy One of Israel.

18329.label: Isaiah 29:20
18329.text: For the tyrant will be no more,The boaster will come to his finish,And all those keeping alert to do harm will be destroyed,

18330.label: Isaiah 29:21
18330.text: Those who with a false word make others guilty,Who lay traps for the defender in the city gate, And who with empty arguments deny justice to the righteous one.

18331.label: Isaiah 29:22
18331.text: So this is what Jehovah, who redeemed Abraham, says to the house of Jacob: “Jacob will no longer be ashamed,And no more will his face grow pale.

18332.label: Isaiah 29:23
18332.text: For when he sees his children,Who are the work of my hands, in his midst, They will sanctify my name;Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob,And they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

18333.label: Isaiah 29:24
18333.text: Those who are wayward in spirit will acquire understanding,And those who complain will accept instruction.”

18334.label: Isaiah 30:1
18334.text: “Woe to the stubborn sons,” declares Jehovah,“Who carry out plans that are not mine, Who make alliances, but not by my spirit,In order to add sin to sin.

18335.label: Isaiah 30:2
18335.text: They go down to Egypt without consulting me, To take shelter under Pharʹaoh’s protection And to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

18336.label: Isaiah 30:3
18336.text: But the protection of Pharʹaoh will become for you a reason for shame,And refuge in Egypt’s shadow a cause for humiliation.

18337.label: Isaiah 30:4
18337.text: For his princes are in Zoʹan, And his envoys have reached Haʹnes.

18338.label: Isaiah 30:5
18338.text: They will all be put to shameBy a people who can bring no benefit to them,Who offer no help and no benefit,Only shame and disgrace.”

18339.label: Isaiah 30:6
18339.text: A pronouncement against the beasts of the south: Through the land of distress and hardship,Of the lion, the roaring lion,Of the viper and the flying fiery snake, They carry their wealth on the backs of donkeysAnd their supplies on the humps of camels. But these things will not benefit the people.

18340.label: Isaiah 30:7
18340.text: For Egypt’s help is completely useless. So I have called this one: “Raʹhab, who sits still.”

18341.label: Isaiah 30:8
18341.text: “Now go, write it on a tablet in their presence,And inscribe it in a book, So that it may serve for a future dayAs a permanent witness.

18342.label: Isaiah 30:9
18342.text: For they are a rebellious people, deceitful sons, Sons who are unwilling to hear the law of Jehovah.

18343.label: Isaiah 30:10
18343.text: They say to the seers, ‘Do not see,’ And to the visionaries, ‘Do not tell us truthful visions. Tell us flattering things; envision deceptive illusions.

18344.label: Isaiah 30:11
18344.text: Turn aside from the way; deviate from the path. Quit putting before us the Holy One of Israel.’”

18345.label: Isaiah 30:12
18345.text: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Since you reject this word And you trust in fraud and deceitAnd you rely on these,

18346.label: Isaiah 30:13
18346.text: So this error will be for you like a broken wall,Like a bulging high wall ready to fall. It will crash suddenly, in an instant.

18347.label: Isaiah 30:14
18347.text: It will be broken like a large potter’s jar,So completely smashed that no fragment among its pieces will be leftTo rake the fire from the fireplaceOr to scoop water from a puddle.”

18348.label: Isaiah 30:15
18348.text: For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, says: “By returning to me and resting, you will be saved;Your strength will be in keeping calm and showing trust.” But you were unwilling.

18349.label: Isaiah 30:16
18349.text: Instead, you said: “No, we will flee on horses!” So flee you will. “And on swift horses we will ride!” So those pursuing you will be swift.

18350.label: Isaiah 30:17
18350.text: A thousand will tremble at the threat of one; At the threat of five you will fleeUntil what is left of you is like a mast on the top of a mountain,Like a signal pole on a hill.

18351.label: Isaiah 30:18
18351.text: But Jehovah is waiting patiently to show you favor, And he will rise up to show you mercy. For Jehovah is a God of justice. Happy are all those keeping in expectation of him.

18352.label: Isaiah 30:19
18352.text: When the people dwell in Zion, in Jerusalem, you will by no means weep. He will surely show you favor at the sound of your cry for help; he will answer you as soon as he hears it.

18353.label: Isaiah 30:20
18353.text: Though Jehovah will give you bread in the form of distress and water in the form of oppression, your Grand Instructor will no longer hide himself, and you will see your Grand Instructor with your own eyes.

18354.label: Isaiah 30:21
18354.text: And your own ears will hear a word behind you saying, “This is the way. Walk in it,” in case you should go to the right or in case you should go to the left.

18355.label: Isaiah 30:22
18355.text: And you will defile the silver overlay of your graven images and the golden plating of your metal statues. You will cast them away like a menstrual cloth and say to them, “Be gone!”

18356.label: Isaiah 30:23
18356.text: And he will give the rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the bread that the ground produces will be abundant and rich. In that day your livestock will graze in spacious pastures.

18357.label: Isaiah 30:24
18357.text: And the cattle and the donkeys that work the ground will eat fodder seasoned with sorrel, which was winnowed with the shovel and the pitchfork.

18358.label: Isaiah 30:25
18358.text: And on every tall mountain and on every high hill will be streams and watercourses, in the day of the great slaughter when the towers fall.

18359.label: Isaiah 30:26
18359.text: And the light of the full moon will become like the light of the sun; and the light of the sun will become seven times stronger, like the light of seven days, in the day that Jehovah binds up the breakdown of his people and heals the severe wound from the blow he inflicted.

18360.label: Isaiah 30:27
18360.text: Look! The name of Jehovah is coming from far away,Burning with his anger and with heavy clouds. His lips are full of indignation,And his tongue is like a consuming fire.

18361.label: Isaiah 30:28
18361.text: His spirit is like a flooding torrent that reaches clear to the neck,To shake the nations in a sieve of destruction; And the peoples will have a bridle in their jaws that leads them astray.

18362.label: Isaiah 30:29
18362.text: But your song will be like the one sung in the nightWhen you prepare for a festival, And your heart will rejoice like oneWho walks with a fluteOn his way to the mountain of Jehovah, to the Rock of Israel.

18363.label: Isaiah 30:30
18363.text: Jehovah will make his majestic voice heardAnd reveal his arm as it descends in the heat of anger, With the flame of a consuming fire, A cloudburst and a thunderstorm and hailstones.

18364.label: Isaiah 30:31
18364.text: For because of the voice of Jehovah, As·syrʹi·a will be struck with terror; He will strike it with a rod.

18365.label: Isaiah 30:32
18365.text: And every swing of his rod of punishmentThat Jehovah will bring down on As·syrʹi·aWill be accompanied by tambourines and harps As he brandishes his arm against them in battle.

18366.label: Isaiah 30:33
18366.text: For his Toʹpheth is already prepared;It is also made ready for the king. He has made the woodpile deep and wide,With an abundance of fire and wood. The breath of Jehovah, like a torrent of sulfur,Will set fire to it.

18367.label: Isaiah 31:1
18367.text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for assistance, Who rely on horses, Who trust in war chariots because they are numerous,And in warhorses because they are mighty. But they do not look to the Holy One of Israel,And they do not search for Jehovah.

18368.label: Isaiah 31:2
18368.text: But he is also wise and will bring calamity,And he will not take back his words. He will rise up against the house of evildoersAnd against those who help wrongdoers.

18369.label: Isaiah 31:3
18369.text: The Egyptians, though, are mere men and not God;Their horses are flesh and not spirit. When Jehovah stretches out his hand,Whoever offers help will stumbleAnd whoever is helped will fall;They will all perish at the same time.

18370.label: Isaiah 31:4
18370.text: For this is what Jehovah has said to me: “Just as the lion growls, a strong young lion, over its prey,When a whole group of shepherds is called together against it,And it is not terrified by their voiceOr daunted by their commotion,So will Jehovah of armies come down to wage warOver Mount Zion and over her hill.

18371.label: Isaiah 31:5
18371.text: Like swooping birds, so Jehovah of armies will defend Jerusalem. He will defend her and save her. He will spare her and rescue her.”

18372.label: Isaiah 31:6
18372.text: “Return to the One against whom you have blatantly revolted, O people of Israel.

18373.label: Isaiah 31:7
18373.text: For in that day each one will reject his worthless gods of silver and his valueless gods of gold, which your own hands sinfully made.

18374.label: Isaiah 31:8
18374.text: And the As·syrʹi·an will fall by the sword, not of a man;And a sword, not of a human, will devour him. He will flee because of the sword,And his young men will be put to forced labor.

18375.label: Isaiah 31:9
18375.text: His crag will pass away because of sheer fright,And his princes will be terrified because of the signal pole,” declares Jehovah,Whose light is in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

18376.label: Isaiah 32:1
18376.text: Look! A king will reign for righteousness, And princes will rule for justice.

18377.label: Isaiah 32:2
18377.text: And each one will be like a hiding place from the wind,A place of concealment from the rainstorm,Like streams of water in a waterless land, Like the shadow of a massive crag in a parched land.

18378.label: Isaiah 32:3
18378.text: Then the eyes of those seeing will no longer be pasted shut,And the ears of those hearing will pay attention.

18379.label: Isaiah 32:4
18379.text: The heart of those who are impetuous will ponder over knowledge,And the stammering tongue will speak fluently and clearly.

18380.label: Isaiah 32:5
18380.text: The senseless one will no longer be called generous,And the unprincipled man will not be called noble;

18381.label: Isaiah 32:6
18381.text: For the senseless one will speak nonsense,And his heart will devise harmful things, To promote apostasy and to speak what is wayward against Jehovah,To cause the hungry one to go unfedAnd to deprive the thirsty one of something to drink.

18382.label: Isaiah 32:7
18382.text: The devices of the unprincipled man are bad; He promotes shameful conductTo ruin the afflicted one with lies, Even when the poor speaks what is right.

18383.label: Isaiah 32:8
18383.text: But the generous one has generous intentions,And in generous endeavors he perseveres.

18384.label: Isaiah 32:9
18384.text: “You complacent women, get up and listen to my voice! You carefree daughters, pay attention to what I say!

18385.label: Isaiah 32:10
18385.text: In a little over a year, you who are carefree will shudder,Because no fruit will have been gathered when the grape harvest ends.

18386.label: Isaiah 32:11
18386.text: Tremble, you complacent women! Shudder, you who are carefree! Strip yourselves bare,And put sackcloth around your hips.

18387.label: Isaiah 32:12
18387.text: Beat your breasts in lamentationOver the desirable fields and the fruitful vine.

18388.label: Isaiah 32:13
18388.text: For the ground of my people will be covered with thorns and briars;They will cover all the houses of rejoicing,Yes, the city of exultation.

18389.label: Isaiah 32:14
18389.text: For the fortified tower has been forsaken;The noisy city has been abandoned. Oʹphel and the watchtower have become a permanent wasteland,A delight for wild donkeys,A pasture for the flocks,

18390.label: Isaiah 32:15
18390.text: Until the spirit is poured out on us from above, And the wilderness becomes an orchard,And the orchard is regarded as a forest.

18391.label: Isaiah 32:16
18391.text: Then justice will reside in the wilderness,And righteousness will dwell in the orchard.

18392.label: Isaiah 32:17
18392.text: The result of true righteousness will be peace, And the fruitage of true righteousness will be lasting tranquility and security.

18393.label: Isaiah 32:18
18393.text: My people will dwell in a peaceful abiding place,In secure dwellings and in tranquil resting-places.

18394.label: Isaiah 32:19
18394.text: But the hail will flatten the forest,And the city will be completely leveled.

18395.label: Isaiah 32:20
18395.text: Happy are you who sow seed alongside all waters,Who send out the bull and the donkey.”

18396.label: Isaiah 33:1
18396.text: Woe to you, you destroyer who has not been destroyed; You betrayer who has not been betrayed! When you finish destroying, you will be destroyed. When you finish betraying, you will be betrayed.

18397.label: Isaiah 33:2
18397.text: O Jehovah, show us favor. Our hope is in you. Become our arm every morning,Yes, our salvation in the time of distress.

18398.label: Isaiah 33:3
18398.text: At the sound of turmoil peoples flee. When you rise up, nations scatter.

18399.label: Isaiah 33:4
18399.text: As the voracious locusts gather, so your spoil will be gathered;People will rush on it like swarms of locusts.

18400.label: Isaiah 33:5
18400.text: Jehovah will be exalted,For he resides in the heights above. He will fill Zion with justice and righteousness.

18401.label: Isaiah 33:6
18401.text: He is the stability of your times;An abundance of salvation, wisdom, knowledge, and the fear of Jehovah —This is his treasure.

18402.label: Isaiah 33:7
18402.text: Look! Their heroes cry out in the street;The messengers of peace weep bitterly.

18403.label: Isaiah 33:8
18403.text: The highways are deserted;There is no one traveling on the pathways. He has broken the covenant;He has rejected the cities;He shows no regard for mortal man.

18404.label: Isaiah 33:9
18404.text: The land mourns and withers away. Lebʹa·non is ashamed; it has decayed. Sharʹon has become like the desert,And Baʹshan and Carʹmel shake off their leaves.

18405.label: Isaiah 33:10
18405.text: “Now I will rise up,” says Jehovah,“Now I will exalt myself; Now I will magnify myself.

18406.label: Isaiah 33:11
18406.text: You conceive dried grass and give birth to stubble. Your own spirit will consume you like a fire.

18407.label: Isaiah 33:12
18407.text: And peoples will become as the burnings of lime. As thorns cut down, they will be set ablaze with fire.

18408.label: Isaiah 33:13
18408.text: You who are far away, listen to what I will do! And you who are nearby, acknowledge my might!

18409.label: Isaiah 33:14
18409.text: The sinners in Zion are in dread; Trembling has seized the apostates: ‘Who of us can live where there is a consuming fire? Who of us can live with unquenchable flames?’

18410.label: Isaiah 33:15
18410.text: The one who walks in continual righteousness, Who speaks what is upright, Who rejects dishonest, fraudulent gain,Whose hands refuse a bribe rather than grabbing it, Who closes his ear to talk of bloodshed,And who shuts his eyes to avoid seeing what is bad

18411.label: Isaiah 33:16
18411.text: —He will reside in the heights;His secure refuge will be in rocky strongholds,His bread will be provided,And his water supply will never fail.”

18412.label: Isaiah 33:17
18412.text: Your eyes will behold a king in his splendor;They will see a land far away.

18413.label: Isaiah 33:18
18413.text: In your heart you will recall the terror: “Where is the secretary? Where is the one who weighed out the tribute? Where is the one who counted the towers?”

18414.label: Isaiah 33:19
18414.text: You will no more see the insolent people,A people whose language is too obscure to comprehend,Whose stammering tongue you cannot understand.

18415.label: Isaiah 33:20
18415.text: Behold Zion, the city of our festivals! Your eyes will see Jerusalem as a tranquil dwelling place,A tent that will not be moved. Never will its tent pins be pulled out,And none of its ropes will be torn apart.

18416.label: Isaiah 33:21
18416.text: But there the Majestic One, Jehovah,Will be for us a region of rivers, of wide canals,Where no galley fleet will goAnd no majestic ships will pass by.

18417.label: Isaiah 33:22
18417.text: For Jehovah is our Judge, Jehovah is our Lawgiver, Jehovah is our King; He is the One who will save us.

18418.label: Isaiah 33:23
18418.text: Your ropes will hang loose;They cannot hold up the mast nor spread the sail. At that time an abundance of spoil will be divided up;Even the lame will take much plunder.

18419.label: Isaiah 33:24
18419.text: And no resident will say: “I am sick.” The people dwelling in the land will be pardoned for their error.

18420.label: Isaiah 34:1
18420.text: Come close to hear, you nations,And pay attention, you peoples. Let the earth and that which fills it listen,The land and all its produce.

18421.label: Isaiah 34:2
18421.text: For Jehovah’s indignation is against all the nations, And his wrath is against all their army. He will devote them to destruction;He will give them to the slaughter.

18422.label: Isaiah 34:3
18422.text: Their slain will be thrown out,And the stench of their carcasses will ascend; The mountains will melt because of their blood.

18423.label: Isaiah 34:4
18423.text: All the army of the heavens will rot away,And the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll. All their army will wither away,As a withered leaf falls from the vineAnd a shriveled fig from the fig tree.

18424.label: Isaiah 34:5
18424.text: “For in the heavens my sword will be drenched. It will descend on Eʹdom in judgment, On the people whom I devoted to destruction.

18425.label: Isaiah 34:6
18425.text: Jehovah has a sword; it will be covered with blood. It will be covered with the fat, With the blood of young rams and goats,With the kidney fat of rams. For Jehovah has a sacrifice in Bozʹrah,A great slaughter in the land of Eʹdom.

18426.label: Isaiah 34:7
18426.text: The wild bulls will go down with them,The young bulls with the powerful ones. Their land will be drenched in blood,And their dust will be soaked with fat.”

18427.label: Isaiah 34:8
18427.text: For Jehovah has a day of vengeance, A year of retribution for the legal case over Zion.

18428.label: Isaiah 34:9
18428.text: Her streams will be changed into pitch,And her dust into sulfur,And her land will become like burning pitch.

18429.label: Isaiah 34:10
18429.text: By night or by day it will not be extinguished;Its smoke will keep ascending forever. From generation to generation she will remain devastated;No one will pass through her forever and ever.

18430.label: Isaiah 34:11
18430.text: The pelican and the porcupine will possess her,And long-eared owls and ravens will reside in her. He will stretch out over her the measuring line of emptinessAnd the plumb line of desolation.

18431.label: Isaiah 34:12
18431.text: None of her nobles will be called to the kingship,And all her princes will come to nothing.

18432.label: Isaiah 34:13
18432.text: Thorns will grow in her fortified towers,Nettles and thorny weeds in her fortresses. She will become a lair of jackals, An enclosure for ostriches.

18433.label: Isaiah 34:14
18433.text: Desert creatures will meet up with howling animals,And the wild goat will call to its companion. Yes, there the nightjar will settle and find a place of rest.

18434.label: Isaiah 34:15
18434.text: There the arrow snake will make its nest and lay eggs,And it will hatch them and gather them in its shadow. Yes, there the kites will gather, each one with her mate.

18435.label: Isaiah 34:16
18435.text: Search in the book of Jehovah and read it out loud: Not one of them will be missing;None of them will be lacking a mate,For it is the mouth of Jehovah that has given the order,And it is his spirit that has gathered them together.

18436.label: Isaiah 34:17
18436.text: He is the One who has cast the lot for them,And his own hand has measured out their assigned place. They will possess it for all time;They will reside in it throughout all generations.

18437.label: Isaiah 35:1
18437.text: The wilderness and the parched land will exult, And the desert plain will be joyful and blossom as the saffron.

18438.label: Isaiah 35:2
18438.text: Without fail it will blossom; It will rejoice and shout for joy. The glory of Lebʹa·non will be given to it, The splendor of Carʹmel and of Sharʹon. They will see the glory of Jehovah, the splendor of our God.

18439.label: Isaiah 35:3
18439.text: Strengthen the weak hands,And make firm the knees that are shaking.

18440.label: Isaiah 35:4
18440.text: Say to those who are anxious at heart: “Be strong. Do not be afraid. Look! Your own God will come with vengeance,God will come with retribution. He will come and save you.”

18441.label: Isaiah 35:5
18441.text: At that time the eyes of the blind will be opened, And the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

18442.label: Isaiah 35:6
18442.text: At that time the lame will leap like the deer, And the tongue of the speechless will shout for joy. For waters will burst forth in the wilderness,And streams in the desert plain.

18443.label: Isaiah 35:7
18443.text: The heat-parched ground will become a reedy pool,And the thirsty ground springs of water. In the lairs where jackals rested, There will be green grass and reeds and papyrus.

18444.label: Isaiah 35:8
18444.text: And a highway will be there, Yes, a way called the Way of Holiness. The unclean one will not travel on it. It is reserved for the one walking on the way;No one foolish will stray onto it.

18445.label: Isaiah 35:9
18445.text: No lion will be there,And no vicious wild beasts will come on it. They will not be found there; Only the repurchased ones will walk there.

18446.label: Isaiah 35:10
18446.text: Those redeemed by Jehovah will return and come to Zion with a joyful cry. Unending joy will crown their heads. Exultation and rejoicing will be theirs,And grief and sighing will flee away.

18447.label: Isaiah 36:1
18447.text: In the 14th year of King Hez·e·kiʹah, Sen·nachʹer·ib the king of As·syrʹi·a came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

18448.label: Isaiah 36:2
18448.text: The king of As·syrʹi·a then sent the Rabʹsha·keh with a vast army from Laʹchish to King Hez·e·kiʹah in Jerusalem. They took up a position by the conduit of the upper pool, which is at the highway of the laundryman’s field.

18449.label: Isaiah 36:3
18449.text: Then E·liʹa·kim son of Hil·kiʹah, who was in charge of the household, Shebʹna the secretary, and Joʹah son of Aʹsaph the recorder came out to him.

18450.label: Isaiah 36:4
18450.text: So the Rabʹsha·keh said to them: “Please, say to Hez·e·kiʹah, ‘This is what the great king, the king of As·syrʹi·a, says: “What is the basis for your confidence?

18451.label: Isaiah 36:5
18451.text: You are saying, ‘I have a strategy and the power to wage war,’ but these are empty words. In whom have you put trust, so that you dare to rebel against me?

18452.label: Isaiah 36:6
18452.text: Look! You trust in the support of this crushed reed, Egypt, which if a man should lean on it would enter into his palm and pierce it. That is the way Pharʹaoh king of Egypt is to all those who trust in him.

18453.label: Isaiah 36:7
18453.text: And if you should say to me, ‘We trust in Jehovah our God,’ is he not the one whose high places and altars Hez·e·kiʹah has removed, while he says to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You should bow down before this altar’?”’

18454.label: Isaiah 36:8
18454.text: So now make this wager, please, with my lord the king of As·syrʹi·a: I will give you 2,000 horses if you are able to find enough riders for them.

18455.label: Isaiah 36:9
18455.text: How, then, could you drive back even one governor who is the least of my lord’s servants, while you put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

18456.label: Isaiah 36:10
18456.text: Now is it without authorization from Jehovah that I have come up against this land to destroy it? Jehovah himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”

18457.label: Isaiah 36:11
18457.text: At this E·liʹa·kim and Shebʹna and Joʹah said to the Rabʹsha·keh: “Speak to your servants, please, in the Ar·a·maʹic language, for we can understand it; do not speak to us in the language of the Jews in the hearing of the people on the wall.”

18458.label: Isaiah 36:12
18458.text: But the Rabʹsha·keh said: “Is it just to your lord and to you that my lord sent me to speak these words? Is it not also to the men who sit on the wall, those who will eat their own excrement and drink their own urine along with you?”

18459.label: Isaiah 36:13
18459.text: Then the Rabʹsha·keh stood and called out loudly in the language of the Jews, saying: “Hear the word of the great king, the king of As·syrʹi·a.

18460.label: Isaiah 36:14
18460.text: This is what the king says, ‘Do not let Hez·e·kiʹah deceive you, for he is not able to rescue you.

18461.label: Isaiah 36:15
18461.text: And do not let Hez·e·kiʹah cause you to trust in Jehovah by saying: “Jehovah will surely rescue us, and this city will not be given into the hand of the king of As·syrʹi·a.”

18462.label: Isaiah 36:16
18462.text: Do not listen to Hez·e·kiʹah, for this is what the king of As·syrʹi·a says: “Make peace with me and surrender, and each of you will eat from his own vine and from his own fig tree and will drink the water of his own cistern,

18463.label: Isaiah 36:17
18463.text: until I come and take you to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

18464.label: Isaiah 36:18
18464.text: Do not let Hez·e·kiʹah mislead you by saying, ‘Jehovah will rescue us.’ Have any of the gods of the nations rescued their land out of the hand of the king of As·syrʹi·a?

18465.label: Isaiah 36:19
18465.text: Where are the gods of Haʹmath and Arʹpad? Where are the gods of Seph·ar·vaʹim? And have they rescued Sa·marʹi·a out of my hand?

18466.label: Isaiah 36:20
18466.text: Who among all the gods of these lands have rescued their land out of my hand, so that Jehovah should rescue Jerusalem out of my hand?”’”

18467.label: Isaiah 36:21
18467.text: But they kept silent and did not say a word to him in reply, for the order of the king was, “You must not answer him.”

18468.label: Isaiah 36:22
18468.text: But E·liʹa·kim son of Hil·kiʹah, who was in charge of the household, Shebʹna the secretary, and Joʹah son of Aʹsaph the recorder came to Hez·e·kiʹah with their garments ripped apart and told him the words of the Rabʹsha·keh.

18469.label: Isaiah 37:1
18469.text: As soon as King Hez·e·kiʹah heard this, he ripped his garments apart and covered himself with sackcloth and went into the house of Jehovah.

18470.label: Isaiah 37:2
18470.text: Then he sent E·liʹa·kim, who was in charge of the household, Shebʹna the secretary, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah, the son of Aʹmoz.

18471.label: Isaiah 37:3
18471.text: They said to him: “This is what Hez·e·kiʹah says, ‘This day is a day of distress, of rebuke, and of disgrace; for the children are ready to be born, but there is no strength to give birth.

18472.label: Isaiah 37:4
18472.text: Perhaps Jehovah your God will hear the words of the Rabʹsha·keh, whom the king of As·syrʹi·a his lord sent to taunt the living God, and he will call him to account for the words that Jehovah your God has heard. So offer up a prayer in behalf of the remnant who have survived.’”

18473.label: Isaiah 37:5
18473.text: So the servants of King Hez·e·kiʹah went in to Isaiah,

18474.label: Isaiah 37:6
18474.text: and Isaiah said to them: “This is what you should say to your lord, ‘This is what Jehovah says: “Do not be afraid because of the words that you heard, the words with which the attendants of the king of As·syrʹi·a blasphemed me.

18475.label: Isaiah 37:7
18475.text: Here I am putting a thought in his mind, and he will hear a report and return to his own land; and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

18476.label: Isaiah 37:8
18476.text: After the Rabʹsha·keh heard that the king of As·syrʹi·a had pulled away from Laʹchish, he returned to him and found him fighting against Libʹnah.

18477.label: Isaiah 37:9
18477.text: Now the king heard it said about King Tir·haʹkah of E·thi·oʹpi·a: “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard this, he sent messengers again to Hez·e·kiʹah, saying:

18478.label: Isaiah 37:10
18478.text: “This is what you should say to King Hez·e·kiʹah of Judah, ‘Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying: “Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of As·syrʹi·a.”

18479.label: Isaiah 37:11
18479.text: Look! You have heard what the kings of As·syrʹi·a did to all the lands by devoting them to destruction. Will you alone be rescued?

18480.label: Isaiah 37:12
18480.text: Did the gods of the nations that my forefathers destroyed rescue them? Where are Goʹzan, Haʹran, Reʹzeph, and the people of Eʹden who were in Tel-asʹsar?

18481.label: Isaiah 37:13
18481.text: Where is the king of Haʹmath, the king of Arʹpad, and the king of the cities of Seph·ar·vaʹim, and of Heʹna, and of Ivʹvah?’”

18482.label: Isaiah 37:14
18482.text: Hez·e·kiʹah took the letters out of the hand of the messengers and read them. Hez·e·kiʹah then went up to the house of Jehovah and spread them out before Jehovah.

18483.label: Isaiah 37:15
18483.text: And Hez·e·kiʹah began to pray to Jehovah and say:

18484.label: Isaiah 37:16
18484.text: “O Jehovah of armies, the God of Israel, sitting enthroned above the cherubs, you alone are the true God of all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.

18485.label: Isaiah 37:17
18485.text: Incline your ear, O Jehovah, and hear! Open your eyes, O Jehovah, and see! Hear all the words that Sen·nachʹer·ib has sent to taunt the living God.

18486.label: Isaiah 37:18
18486.text: It is a fact, O Jehovah, that the kings of As·syrʹi·a have devastated all the lands, as well as their own land.

18487.label: Isaiah 37:19
18487.text: And they have thrown their gods into the fire, because they were not gods but the work of human hands, wood and stone. That is why they could destroy them.

18488.label: Isaiah 37:20
18488.text: But now, O Jehovah our God, save us out of his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you alone are God, O Jehovah.”

18489.label: Isaiah 37:21
18489.text: Isaiah son of Aʹmoz then sent this message to Hez·e·kiʹah: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel says, ‘Because you prayed to me concerning King Sen·nachʹer·ib of As·syrʹi·a,

18490.label: Isaiah 37:22
18490.text: this is the word that Jehovah has spoken against him: “The virgin daughter of Zion despises you, she scoffs at you. The daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head at you.

18491.label: Isaiah 37:23
18491.text: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice And lifted your arrogant eyes? It is against the Holy One of Israel!

18492.label: Isaiah 37:24
18492.text: Through your servants you have taunted Jehovah and said,‘With the multitude of my war chariotsI will ascend the heights of mountains, The remotest parts of Lebʹa·non. I will cut down its lofty cedars, its choice juniper trees. I will enter its highest retreats, its densest forests.

18493.label: Isaiah 37:25
18493.text: I will dig wells and drink waters;I will dry up the streams of Egypt with the soles of my feet.’

18494.label: Isaiah 37:26
18494.text: Have you not heard? From long ago it was determined. From days gone by I have prepared it. Now I will bring it about. You will turn fortified cities into desolate piles of ruins.

18495.label: Isaiah 37:27
18495.text: Their inhabitants will be helpless;They will be terrified and put to shame. They will become as vegetation of the field and green grass,As grass of the roofs that is scorched by the east wind.

18496.label: Isaiah 37:28
18496.text: But I well know when you sit, when you go out, when you come in, And when you are enraged against me,

18497.label: Isaiah 37:29
18497.text: Because your rage against me and your roaring have reached my ears. So I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle between your lips,And I will lead you back the way you came.”

18498.label: Isaiah 37:30
18498.text: “‘And this will be the sign for you: This year you will eat what grows on its own; and in the second year, you will eat grain that sprouts from that; but in the third year you will sow seed and reap, and you will plant vineyards and eat their fruitage.

18499.label: Isaiah 37:31
18499.text: Those of the house of Judah who escape, those who are left, will take root downward and produce fruit upward.

18500.label: Isaiah 37:32
18500.text: For a remnant will go out of Jerusalem and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of Jehovah of armies will do this.

18501.label: Isaiah 37:33
18501.text: “‘Therefore this is what Jehovah says about the king of As·syrʹi·a: “He will not come into this city Or shoot an arrow thereOr confront it with a shieldOr cast up a siege rampart against it.”’

18502.label: Isaiah 37:34
18502.text: ‘By the way he came he will return;He will not come into this city,’ declares Jehovah.

18503.label: Isaiah 37:35
18503.text: ‘I will defend this city and save it for my own sake And for the sake of my servant David.’”

18504.label: Isaiah 37:36
18504.text: And the angel of Jehovah went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the As·syrʹi·ans. When people rose up early in the morning, they saw all the dead bodies.

18505.label: Isaiah 37:37
18505.text: So King Sen·nachʹer·ib of As·syrʹi·a departed and returned to Ninʹe·veh and stayed there.

18506.label: Isaiah 37:38
18506.text: And as he was bowing down at the house of his god Nisʹroch, his own sons A·dramʹme·lech and Shar·eʹzer struck him down with the sword and then escaped to the land of Arʹa·rat. And his son Eʹsar-hadʹdon became king in his place.

18507.label: Isaiah 38:1
18507.text: In those days Hez·e·kiʹah became sick and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah the son of Aʹmoz came and said to him, “This is what Jehovah says: ‘Give instructions to your household, for you will die; you will not recover.’”

18508.label: Isaiah 38:2
18508.text: At that Hez·e·kiʹah turned his face to the wall and began to pray to Jehovah:

18509.label: Isaiah 38:3
18509.text: “I beg you, O Jehovah, remember, please, how I have walked before you faithfully and with a complete heart, and I have done what was good in your eyes.” And Hez·e·kiʹah began to weep profusely.

18510.label: Isaiah 38:4
18510.text: Then the word of Jehovah came to Isaiah, saying:

18511.label: Isaiah 38:5
18511.text: “Go back and say to Hez·e·kiʹah, ‘This is what Jehovah the God of David your forefather says: “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Here I am adding 15 years to your life,

18512.label: Isaiah 38:6
18512.text: and I will rescue you and this city out of the hand of the king of As·syrʹi·a, and I will defend this city.

18513.label: Isaiah 38:7
18513.text: This is the sign from Jehovah to show you that Jehovah will carry out the word that he has spoken:

18514.label: Isaiah 38:8
18514.text: Here I will make the declining shadow of the sun on the stairway of Aʹhaz go back ten steps.”’” So the sun went back ten steps on the stairway that it had already descended.

18515.label: Isaiah 38:9
18515.text: A writing of King Hez·e·kiʹah of Judah when he became sick and recovered from his sickness.

18516.label: Isaiah 38:10
18516.text: I said: “In the middle of my lifeI must go into the gates of the Grave. I will be deprived of my remaining years.”

18517.label: Isaiah 38:11
18517.text: I said: “I will not see Jah, Jah in the land of the living. I will look no more on mankindWhen I am with the inhabitants of the place where everything ceases.

18518.label: Isaiah 38:12
18518.text: My own dwelling has been pulled out and removed from me Like the tent of a shepherd. I have rolled up my life like a loom worker;He cuts me off like the threads of the warp. From daylight to nightfall you keep bringing me to an end.

18519.label: Isaiah 38:13
18519.text: I calm myself until the morning. Like a lion, he keeps breaking all my bones;From daylight to nightfall you keep bringing me to an end.

18520.label: Isaiah 38:14
18520.text: Like the swift or the thrush, so I keep chirping; I keep cooing like the dove. My eyes look wearily to the height: ‘O Jehovah, I am in great distress;Be my support!’

18521.label: Isaiah 38:15
18521.text: What can I say? He has spoken to me and acted. I will walk humbly all my yearsBecause of my bitter distress.

18522.label: Isaiah 38:16
18522.text: ‘O Jehovah, by these things every man lives,And in them is the life of my spirit. You will restore me to health and preserve me alive.

18523.label: Isaiah 38:17
18523.text: Look! Instead of peace, I had great bitterness;But in your fondness for me, You preserved me from the pit of destruction. You have thrown all my sins behind your back.

18524.label: Isaiah 38:18
18524.text: For the Grave cannot glorify you, Death cannot praise you. Those who go down into the pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.

18525.label: Isaiah 38:19
18525.text: The living, the living can praise you,Just as I can this day. A father can give his sons knowledge about your faithfulness.

18526.label: Isaiah 38:20
18526.text: O Jehovah, save me,And we will play my songs on stringed instruments All the days of our life at the house of Jehovah.’”

18527.label: Isaiah 38:21
18527.text: Isaiah then said: “Bring a cake of pressed dried figs and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover.”

18528.label: Isaiah 38:22
18528.text: Hez·e·kiʹah had asked: “What is the sign that I will go up to the house of Jehovah?”

18529.label: Isaiah 39:1
18529.text: At that time the king of Babylon, Merʹo·dach-balʹa·dan son of Balʹa·dan, sent letters and a gift to Hez·e·kiʹah, for he had heard that he had been sick and had recovered.

18530.label: Isaiah 39:2
18530.text: Hez·e·kiʹah gladly welcomed them and showed them his treasure-house —the silver, the gold, the balsam oil and other precious oil, his whole armory, and everything that was to be found in his treasuries. There was nothing that Hez·e·kiʹah did not show them in his own house and in all his dominion.

18531.label: Isaiah 39:3
18531.text: After that Isaiah the prophet came in to King Hez·e·kiʹah and asked him: “What did these men say, and where did they come from?” So Hez·e·kiʹah said: “They came from a distant land, from Babylon.”

18532.label: Isaiah 39:4
18532.text: Next he asked: “What did they see in your house?” Hez·e·kiʹah replied: “They saw everything in my house. There was nothing that I did not show them in my treasuries.”

18533.label: Isaiah 39:5
18533.text: Isaiah now said to Hez·e·kiʹah: “Hear the word of Jehovah of armies,

18534.label: Isaiah 39:6
18534.text: ‘Look! Days are coming, and all that is in your house and all that your forefathers have stored up to this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Jehovah.

18535.label: Isaiah 39:7
18535.text: ‘And some of your own sons to whom you will become father will be taken and will become court officials in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

18536.label: Isaiah 39:8
18536.text: At that Hez·e·kiʹah said to Isaiah: “The word of Jehovah that you have spoken is good.” Then he added: “Because there will be peace and stability during my lifetime.”

18537.label: Isaiah 40:1
18537.text: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

18538.label: Isaiah 40:2
18538.text: “Speak to the heart of Jerusalem,And proclaim to her that her compulsory service has been fulfilled,That her guilt has been paid off. From the hand of Jehovah she has received a full amount for all her sins.”

18539.label: Isaiah 40:3
18539.text: A voice of one calling out in the wilderness: “Clear up the way of Jehovah! Make a straight highway through the desert for our God.

18540.label: Isaiah 40:4
18540.text: Let every valley be raised up,And every mountain and hill be made low. The rough ground must become level,And the rugged ground a valley plain.

18541.label: Isaiah 40:5
18541.text: The glory of Jehovah will be revealed, And all flesh will see it together, For the mouth of Jehovah has spoken.”

18542.label: Isaiah 40:6
18542.text: Listen! Someone is saying: “Call out!” Another asks: “What should I call out?” “All flesh is green grass. All their loyal love is like the blossom of the field.

18543.label: Isaiah 40:7
18543.text: The green grass dries up,The blossom withers, Because the breath of Jehovah blows upon it. Surely the people are but green grass.

18544.label: Isaiah 40:8
18544.text: The green grass dries up,The blossom withers,But the word of our God endures forever.”

18545.label: Isaiah 40:9
18545.text: Go up onto a high mountain,You woman bringing good news for Zion. Raise your voice with power,You woman bringing good news for Jerusalem. Raise it, do not be afraid. Announce to the cities of Judah: “Here is your God.”

18546.label: Isaiah 40:10
18546.text: Look! The Sovereign Lord Jehovah will come with power,And his arm will rule for him. Look! His reward is with him,And the wage he pays is before him.

18547.label: Isaiah 40:11
18547.text: Like a shepherd he will care for his flock. With his arm he will gather together the lambs,And in his bosom he will carry them. He will gently lead those nursing their young.

18548.label: Isaiah 40:12
18548.text: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand And taken the measurements of the heavens with a span of his hand? Who has gathered in a measure the dust of the earth Or weighed the mountains in the balancesAnd the hills in the scales?

18549.label: Isaiah 40:13
18549.text: Who has taken the measurements of the spirit of Jehovah,And who can instruct him as his adviser?

18550.label: Isaiah 40:14
18550.text: With whom did he consult to gain understanding,Or who teaches him in the path of justice,Or teaches him knowledge,Or shows him the way of true understanding?

18551.label: Isaiah 40:15
18551.text: Look! The nations are like a drop from a bucket,And as the film of dust on the scales they are regarded. Look! He lifts up the islands like fine dust.

18552.label: Isaiah 40:16
18552.text: Even Lebʹa·non is not sufficient to keep a fire burning, And its wild animals are not sufficient for a burnt offering.

18553.label: Isaiah 40:17
18553.text: All the nations are as something nonexistent in front of him; He regards them as nothing, as an unreality.

18554.label: Isaiah 40:18
18554.text: To whom can you compare God? What likeness can you put next to him?

18555.label: Isaiah 40:19
18555.text: The craftsman casts an idol, The metalworker overlays it with gold, And he forges silver chains.

18556.label: Isaiah 40:20
18556.text: He chooses a tree for his contribution, A tree that will not rot. He searches for a skilled craftsmanTo prepare a carved image that will not topple over.

18557.label: Isaiah 40:21
18557.text: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been told to you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?

18558.label: Isaiah 40:22
18558.text: There is One who dwells above the circle of the earth, And its inhabitants are like grasshoppers. He is stretching out the heavens like a fine gauze,And he spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.

18559.label: Isaiah 40:23
18559.text: He reduces high officials to nothingAnd makes the judges of the earth an unreality.

18560.label: Isaiah 40:24
18560.text: They are hardly planted,They are hardly sown,Their stem has hardly taken root in the earth,And they are blown on and dry up,And the wind carries them away like stubble.

18561.label: Isaiah 40:25
18561.text: “To whom can you liken me to make me his equal?” says the Holy One.

18562.label: Isaiah 40:26
18562.text: “Lift up your eyes to heaven and see. Who has created these things? It is the One who brings out their army by number;He calls them all by name. Because of his vast dynamic energy and his awe-inspiring power, Not one of them is missing.

18563.label: Isaiah 40:27
18563.text: Why do you say, O Jacob, and why do you declare, O Israel,‘My way is hidden from Jehovah,And I receive no justice from God’?

18564.label: Isaiah 40:28
18564.text: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, is a God for all eternity. He never tires out or grows weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

18565.label: Isaiah 40:29
18565.text: He gives power to the tired oneAnd full might to those lacking strength.

18566.label: Isaiah 40:30
18566.text: Boys will tire out and grow weary,And young men will stumble and fall,

18567.label: Isaiah 40:31
18567.text: But those hoping in Jehovah will regain power. They will soar on wings like eagles. They will run and not grow weary;They will walk and not tire out.”

18568.label: Isaiah 41:1
18568.text: “Listen to me in silence, you islands;Let the nations regain their strength. Let them approach; then let them speak. Let us come together for judgment.

18569.label: Isaiah 41:2
18569.text: Who has raised up someone from the sunrise, Calling him in righteousness to His feet, To hand over nations to himAnd to make him subdue kings? Who reduces them to dust before his sword,Like windblown stubble before his bow?

18570.label: Isaiah 41:3
18570.text: He pursues them, passing along unhinderedOver paths that his feet have not traveled.

18571.label: Isaiah 41:4
18571.text: Who has acted and done this,Summoning the generations from the beginning? I, Jehovah, am the First One; And with the last ones I am the same.”

18572.label: Isaiah 41:5
18572.text: The islands have seen it and have become afraid. The ends of the earth began to tremble. They draw near and come forward.

18573.label: Isaiah 41:6
18573.text: Each one helps his companionAnd says to his brother: “Be strong.”

18574.label: Isaiah 41:7
18574.text: So the craftsman strengthens the metalworker; The one who flattens with the forge hammerStrengthens the one hammering at the anvil. He says about the soldering: “It is good.” Then it is fastened with nails so that it will not topple over.

18575.label: Isaiah 41:8
18575.text: “But you, O Israel, are my servant, You, O Jacob, whom I have chosen, The offspring of Abraham my friend,

18576.label: Isaiah 41:9
18576.text: You, whom I took from the ends of the earth, And you, whom I called from its most distant parts. I said to you, ‘You are my servant; I have chosen you; I have not rejected you.

18577.label: Isaiah 41:10
18577.text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you. Do not be anxious, for I am your God. I will fortify you, yes, I will help you, I will really hold on to you with my right hand of righteousness.’

18578.label: Isaiah 41:11
18578.text: Look! All those getting enraged against you will be put to shame and humiliated. Those who fight with you will be brought to nothing and perish.

18579.label: Isaiah 41:12
18579.text: You will search for men who struggle with you, but you will not find them;The men at war with you will become as something nonexistent, as nothing at all.

18580.label: Isaiah 41:13
18580.text: For I, Jehovah your God, am grasping your right hand,The One saying to you, ‘Do not be afraid. I will help you.’

18581.label: Isaiah 41:14
18581.text: Do not be afraid, you worm Jacob, You men of Israel, I will help you,” declares Jehovah, your Repurchaser, the Holy One of Israel.

18582.label: Isaiah 41:15
18582.text: “Look! I have made you a threshing sledge, A new threshing instrument with double-edged teeth. You will tread down the mountains and crush themAnd make the hills like chaff.

18583.label: Isaiah 41:16
18583.text: You will winnow them,And the wind will carry them away;A windstorm will scatter them. You will be joyful in Jehovah, And you will boast in the Holy One of Israel.”

18584.label: Isaiah 41:17
18584.text: “The needy and the poor are seeking water, but there is none. Their tongue is dry from thirst. I, Jehovah, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not abandon them.

18585.label: Isaiah 41:18
18585.text: I will make rivers flow on the bare hills And springs in the valley plains. I will turn the wilderness into a reedy pool of waterAnd the waterless land into springs of water.

18586.label: Isaiah 41:19
18586.text: In the desert I will plant the cedar tree,The acacia and the myrtle and the pine tree. In the desert plain I will plant the juniper tree,Together with the ash and the cypress tree,

18587.label: Isaiah 41:20
18587.text: So that all people may see and knowAnd pay attention and understandThat the hand of Jehovah has done this,And the Holy One of Israel has created it.”

18588.label: Isaiah 41:21
18588.text: “Present your case,” says Jehovah. “Produce your arguments,” says the King of Jacob.

18589.label: Isaiah 41:22
18589.text: “Produce evidence and tell us the things that will happen. Do tell us about the former things,So that we may reflect on them and know their outcome. Or declare to us the things that are coming.

18590.label: Isaiah 41:23
18590.text: Tell us what will happen in the future,So that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something, good or bad,So that we may be amazed when we see it.

18591.label: Isaiah 41:24
18591.text: Look! You are something nonexistent,And your achievement is nothing. Anyone who chooses you is detestable.

18592.label: Isaiah 41:25
18592.text: I have raised up someone from the north, and he will come, One from the rising of the sun who will call on my name. He will trample rulers as if they were clay, Like a potter who treads moist clay.

18593.label: Isaiah 41:26
18593.text: Who told about this from the beginning, so that we could know,Or from times past, so that we could say, ‘He is right’? Indeed, no one announced it! No one declared it! No one heard anything from you!”

18594.label: Isaiah 41:27
18594.text: I was the first to say to Zion: “Look! Here they are!” And to Jerusalem I will send a bearer of good news.

18595.label: Isaiah 41:28
18595.text: But I kept looking, and there was no one;There was not one among them to give advice. And I kept asking them to reply.

18596.label: Isaiah 41:29
18596.text: Look! All of them are a delusion. Their works are nothing. Their metal images are wind and unreality.

18597.label: Isaiah 42:1
18597.text: Look! My servant, whom I support! My chosen one, whom I have approved! I have put my spirit in him; He will bring justice to the nations.

18598.label: Isaiah 42:2
18598.text: He will not cry out or raise his voice,And he will not make his voice heard in the street.

18599.label: Isaiah 42:3
18599.text: No crushed reed will he break,And no smoldering wick will he extinguish. In faithfulness he will bring justice.

18600.label: Isaiah 42:4
18600.text: He will not grow dim or be crushed until he establishes justice in the earth; And the islands keep waiting for his law.

18601.label: Isaiah 42:5
18601.text: This is what the true God, Jehovah, says,The Creator of the heavens and the Grand One who stretched them out, The One who spread out the earth and its produce, The One who gives breath to the people on it And spirit to those who walk on it:

18602.label: Isaiah 42:6
18602.text: “I, Jehovah, have called you in righteousness;I have taken hold of your hand. I will safeguard you and give you as a covenant for the people And as a light of the nations,

18603.label: Isaiah 42:7
18603.text: For you to open the blind eyes, To bring the prisoner out of the dungeonAnd those sitting in darkness out of the prison.

18604.label: Isaiah 42:8
18604.text: I am Jehovah. That is my name;I give my glory to no one else, Nor my praise to graven images.

18605.label: Isaiah 42:9
18605.text: See, the first things have come to pass;Now I am declaring new things. Before they spring up, I tell you about them.”

18606.label: Isaiah 42:10
18606.text: Sing to Jehovah a new song, His praise from the ends of the earth, You who go down to the sea and all that fills it,You islands and their inhabitants.

18607.label: Isaiah 42:11
18607.text: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voice, The settlements where Keʹdar dwells. Let the inhabitants of the crag shout joyfully;Let them cry out from the top of the mountains.

18608.label: Isaiah 42:12
18608.text: Let them attribute glory to JehovahAnd declare his praise in the islands.

18609.label: Isaiah 42:13
18609.text: Jehovah will go out like a mighty man. He will awaken his zeal like a warrior. He will shout, yes, he will let out a war cry;He will show himself mightier than his enemies.

18610.label: Isaiah 42:14
18610.text: “I have kept quiet for a long time. I remained silent and restrained myself. Like a woman giving birth,I will groan, pant, and gasp all at once.

18611.label: Isaiah 42:15
18611.text: I will devastate mountains and hillsAnd dry up all their vegetation. I will turn rivers into islands And dry up reedy pools of water.

18612.label: Isaiah 42:16
18612.text: I will lead the blind in a way that they do not know And cause them to tread on unfamiliar paths. I will turn the darkness before them into light And turn the rugged terrain into level land. This is what I will do for them, and I will not abandon them.”

18613.label: Isaiah 42:17
18613.text: They will be turned back and will be utterly put to shame,Those who trust in carved images,Those who say to metal statues: “You are our gods.”

18614.label: Isaiah 42:18
18614.text: Listen, you who are deaf;Look and see, you who are blind.

18615.label: Isaiah 42:19
18615.text: Who is blind except my servant,So deaf as the messenger I send? Who is so blind as the one rewarded,So blind as the servant of Jehovah?

18616.label: Isaiah 42:20
18616.text: You see many things, but you do not keep watch. You open your ears, but you do not listen.

18617.label: Isaiah 42:21
18617.text: For the sake of his righteousness,Jehovah has taken pleasure in magnifying the law and making it glorious.

18618.label: Isaiah 42:22
18618.text: But this is a people plundered and pillaged; All of them are trapped in the holes and hidden in the prisons. They have been plundered with no one to rescue them, And pillaged with no one to say: “Bring them back!”

18619.label: Isaiah 42:23
18619.text: Who among you will hear this? Who will pay attention and listen for the time to come?

18620.label: Isaiah 42:24
18620.text: Who has given Jacob for pillageAnd Israel to the plunderers? Is it not Jehovah, the One against whom we sinned? In His ways they refused to walk,And His law they would not obey.

18621.label: Isaiah 42:25
18621.text: So He kept pouring out on him wrath,His anger and the fury of war. It consumed everything around him, but he paid no attention. It blazed up against him, but he would not take it to heart.

18622.label: Isaiah 43:1
18622.text: Now this is what Jehovah says,Your Creator, O Jacob, the One who formed you, O Israel: “Do not be afraid, for I have repurchased you. I have called you by your name. You belong to me.

18623.label: Isaiah 43:2
18623.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, And through the rivers, they will not flood over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched,Nor will the flame singe you.

18624.label: Isaiah 43:3
18624.text: For I am Jehovah your God,The Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as a ransom for you,E·thi·oʹpi·a and Seʹba in exchange for you.

18625.label: Isaiah 43:4
18625.text: For you became precious in my eyes, You were honored, and I have loved you. So I will give people in place of youAnd nations in exchange for your life.

18626.label: Isaiah 43:5
18626.text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the eastAnd gather you together from the west.

18627.label: Isaiah 43:6
18627.text: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ And to the south, ‘Do not hold them back. Bring my sons from afar, and my daughters from the ends of the earth,

18628.label: Isaiah 43:7
18628.text: Everyone who is called by my name And whom I created for my own glory,Whom I have formed and made.’

18629.label: Isaiah 43:8
18629.text: Bring out a people who are blind, though they have eyes,And who are deaf, though they have ears.

18630.label: Isaiah 43:9
18630.text: Let all the nations assemble in one place,And let the peoples be gathered together. Who among them can tell this? Or can they cause us to hear the first things? Let them present their witnesses to prove themselves right,Or let them hear and say, ‘It is the truth!’”

18631.label: Isaiah 43:10
18631.text: “You are my witnesses,” declares Jehovah,“Yes, my servant whom I have chosen, So that you may know and have faith in me And understand that I am the same One. Before me no God was formed,And after me there has been none.

18632.label: Isaiah 43:11
18632.text: I—I am Jehovah, and besides me there is no savior.”

18633.label: Isaiah 43:12
18633.text: “I am the One who declared and saved and made knownWhen there was no foreign god among you. So you are my witnesses,” declares Jehovah, “and I am God.

18634.label: Isaiah 43:13
18634.text: Also, I am always the same One; And no one can snatch anything out of my hand. When I act, who can prevent it?”

18635.label: Isaiah 43:14
18635.text: This is what Jehovah says, your Repurchaser, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sakes I will send to Babylon and bring down all the bars of the gates, And the Chal·deʹans, in their ships, will cry out in distress.

18636.label: Isaiah 43:15
18636.text: I am Jehovah, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

18637.label: Isaiah 43:16
18637.text: This is what Jehovah says,The One making a way through the seaAnd a path even through turbulent waters,

18638.label: Isaiah 43:17
18638.text: The One who draws out the war chariot and the horse, The army together with the mighty warriors: “They will lie down and not get up. They will be extinguished, snuffed out like a burning wick.”

18639.label: Isaiah 43:18
18639.text: “Do not remember the former things,And do not dwell on the past.

18640.label: Isaiah 43:19
18640.text: Look! I am doing something new; Even now it is springing up. Do you not recognize it? I will make a way through the wilderness And rivers through the desert.

18641.label: Isaiah 43:20
18641.text: The wild beast of the field will honor me,The jackals and the ostriches,For I provide water in the wilderness,Rivers in the desert, For my people, my chosen one, to drink,

18642.label: Isaiah 43:21
18642.text: The people whom I formed for myselfSo that they might declare my praise.

18643.label: Isaiah 43:22
