18643.text: But you have not called on me, O Jacob, Because you grew weary of me, O Israel.

18644.label: Isaiah 43:23
18644.text: You have not brought me sheep for your whole burnt offeringsOr glorified me with your sacrifices. I have not compelled you to bring me a gift,Nor have I made you weary by demanding frankincense.

18645.label: Isaiah 43:24
18645.text: You did not buy me sweet cane with your money,And with the fat of your sacrifices you did not satisfy me. Instead, you have burdened me with your sinsAnd made me weary with your errors.

18646.label: Isaiah 43:25
18646.text: I, I am the One who is blotting out your transgressions for my own sake, And I will not remember your sins.

18647.label: Isaiah 43:26
18647.text: Remind me; let us bring our case against each other;Tell your side of it to prove you are in the right.

18648.label: Isaiah 43:27
18648.text: Your first forefather sinned,And your own spokesmen have rebelled against me.

18649.label: Isaiah 43:28
18649.text: So I will profane the princes of the holy place,And I will give Jacob over to destructionAnd subject Israel to insulting words.

18650.label: Isaiah 44:1
18650.text: “Now listen, O Jacob my servant,And you, O Israel, whom I have chosen.

18651.label: Isaiah 44:2
18651.text: This is what Jehovah says,Your Maker and the One who formed you, Who has helped you from the womb: ‘Do not be afraid, my servant Jacob, And you, Jeshʹu·run, whom I have chosen.

18652.label: Isaiah 44:3
18652.text: For I will pour out water on the thirsty one And flowing streams on the dry ground. I will pour out my spirit on your offspring And my blessing on your descendants.

18653.label: Isaiah 44:4
18653.text: And they will spring up as among the green grass, Like poplars by the streams of water.

18654.label: Isaiah 44:5
18654.text: One will say: “I belong to Jehovah.” Another will call himself by the name of Jacob,And yet another will write on his hand: “Belonging to Jehovah.” And he will adopt the name of Israel.’

18655.label: Isaiah 44:6
18655.text: This is what Jehovah says,The King of Israel and his Repurchaser, Jehovah of armies: ‘I am the first and I am the last. There is no God but me.

18656.label: Isaiah 44:7
18656.text: Who is there like me? Let him call out and tell it and prove it to me! From the time I established the people of long ago,Let them tell both the things to comeAnd what will yet happen.

18657.label: Isaiah 44:8
18657.text: Do not be in dread,And do not become paralyzed with fear. Have I not told each of you beforehand and declared it? You are my witnesses. Is there any God but me? No, there is no other Rock; I know of none.’”

18658.label: Isaiah 44:9
18658.text: All who form carved images amount to nothing,And their cherished objects will be of no benefit. As their witnesses, they see nothing and know nothing, So those who made them will be put to shame.

18659.label: Isaiah 44:10
18659.text: Who would form a god or cast a metal image That can bring no benefit?

18660.label: Isaiah 44:11
18660.text: Look! All his associates will be put to shame! The craftsmen are mere humans. Let them all assemble and take their stand. They will be terrified and be put to shame together.

18661.label: Isaiah 44:12
18661.text: The metalsmith works the iron over the coals with his tool. He forms it with hammers,Working it with his powerful arm. Then he grows hungry and his strength fails;He drinks no water and grows tired.

18662.label: Isaiah 44:13
18662.text: The wood-carver stretches the measuring line, tracing out the pattern with red chalk. He works it with a wood scraper and traces it with a compass. He patterns it after a man, With the beauty of a man,To sit in a house.

18663.label: Isaiah 44:14
18663.text: There is one whose work is to cut down cedars. He selects a certain type of tree, an oak,And he lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel tree, and the rain makes it grow.

18664.label: Isaiah 44:15
18664.text: Then it becomes fuel for a man to make fires. He takes part of it to warm himself;He builds a fire and bakes bread. But he also makes a god and worships it. He makes it into a carved image, and he bows down before it.

18665.label: Isaiah 44:16
18665.text: Half of it he burns up in a fire;With that half he roasts the meat that he eats, and he is satisfied. He also warms himself and says: “Ah! I am warm as I watch the fire.”

18666.label: Isaiah 44:17
18666.text: But the rest of it he makes into a god, into his carved image. He bows down to it and worships it. He prays to it and says: “Save me, for you are my god.”

18667.label: Isaiah 44:18
18667.text: They know nothing, they understand nothing, Because their eyes are sealed shut and they cannot see,And their heart has no insight.

18668.label: Isaiah 44:19
18668.text: No one reflects in his heartOr has knowledge or understanding, saying: “Half of it I burned up in a fire,And on its coals I baked bread and roasted meat to eat. Should I, then, make the rest of it into a detestable thing? Should I worship a block of wood from a tree?”

18669.label: Isaiah 44:20
18669.text: He feeds on ashes. His own deluded heart has led him astray. He cannot save himself, nor does he say: “Is there not a lie in my right hand?”

18670.label: Isaiah 44:21
18670.text: “Remember these things, O Jacob, and you, O Israel,For you are my servant. I formed you, and you are my servant. O Israel, I will not forget you.

18671.label: Isaiah 44:22
18671.text: I will blot out your transgressions as with a cloud And your sins as with a thick cloud. Return to me, for I will repurchase you.

18672.label: Isaiah 44:23
18672.text: Shout joyfully, you heavens,For Jehovah has acted! Shout in triumph, you depths of the earth! Shout for joy, you mountains, You forest, and all your trees! For Jehovah has repurchased Jacob,And on Israel he displays his splendor.”

18673.label: Isaiah 44:24
18673.text: This is what Jehovah says, your Repurchaser, Who formed you since you were in the womb: “I am Jehovah, who made everything. I stretched out the heavens by myself, And I spread out the earth. Who was with me?

18674.label: Isaiah 44:25
18674.text: I am frustrating the signs of the empty talkers, And I am the One who makes diviners act like fools; The One confounding the wise menAnd turning their knowledge into foolishness;

18675.label: Isaiah 44:26
18675.text: The One making the word of his servant come trueAnd completely fulfilling the predictions of his messengers; The One saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited,’ And of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be rebuilt, And I will restore her ruins’;

18676.label: Isaiah 44:27
18676.text: The One saying to the deep waters, ‘Be evaporated,And I will dry up all your rivers’;

18677.label: Isaiah 44:28
18677.text: The One saying of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd,And he will completely carry out all my will’; The One saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ And of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

18678.label: Isaiah 45:1
18678.text: This is what Jehovah says to his anointed one, to Cyrus, Whose right hand I have taken hold of To subdue nations before him, To disarm kings,To open before him the double doors,So that the gates will not be shut:

18679.label: Isaiah 45:2
18679.text: “Before you I will go, And the hills I will level. The copper doors I will break in pieces,And the iron bars I will cut down.

18680.label: Isaiah 45:3
18680.text: I will give you the treasures in the darknessAnd the hidden treasures in the concealed places, So that you may know that I am Jehovah,The God of Israel, who is calling you by your name.

18681.label: Isaiah 45:4
18681.text: For the sake of my servant Jacob and of Israel my chosen one,I am calling you by your name. I am giving you a name of honor, although you did not know me.

18682.label: Isaiah 45:5
18682.text: I am Jehovah, and there is no one else. There is no God except me. I will strengthen you, although you did not know me,

18683.label: Isaiah 45:6
18683.text: In order that people may knowFrom the rising of the sun to its setting That there is none besides me. I am Jehovah, and there is no one else.

18684.label: Isaiah 45:7
18684.text: I form light and create darkness, I make peace and create calamity; I, Jehovah, am doing all these things.

18685.label: Isaiah 45:8
18685.text: You heavens, rain down from above; Let the clouds pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up and be fruitful with salvation,And let it cause righteousness to spring up at the same time. I, Jehovah, have created it.”

18686.label: Isaiah 45:9
18686.text: Woe to the one who contends with his Maker, For he is just an earthenware fragmentAmong the other earthenware fragments lying on the ground! Should the clay say to the Potter: “What are you making?” Or should your work say: “He has no hands”?

18687.label: Isaiah 45:10
18687.text: Woe to the one who says to a father: “What do you become father to?” And to a woman: “What are you giving birth to?”

18688.label: Isaiah 45:11
18688.text: This is what Jehovah says, the Holy One of Israel, the One who formed him: “Would you question me about the things comingAnd command me about my sons and the works of my hands?

18689.label: Isaiah 45:12
18689.text: I made the earth and created man on it. I stretched out the heavens with my own hands, And I give orders to all their army.”

18690.label: Isaiah 45:13
18690.text: “I have raised up a man in righteousness, And I will make all his ways straight. He is the one who will build my city And set my exiles free without a price or a bribe,” says Jehovah of armies.

18691.label: Isaiah 45:14
18691.text: This is what Jehovah says: “The profit of Egypt and the merchandise of E·thi·oʹpi·a and the Sa·beʹans, tall of stature,Will come over to you and become yours. They will walk behind you in chains. They will come over and bow down to you. To you they will say in prayer, ‘Surely God is with you, And there is no one else; there is no other God.’”

18692.label: Isaiah 45:15
18692.text: Truly you are a God who conceals himself,O God of Israel, the Savior.

18693.label: Isaiah 45:16
18693.text: They will all be put to shame and be humiliated;The makers of idols will all go off in disgrace.

18694.label: Isaiah 45:17
18694.text: But Israel will be saved by Jehovah with an everlasting salvation. You will not be put to shame or disgraced for all eternity.

18695.label: Isaiah 45:18
18695.text: For this is what Jehovah says,The Creator of the heavens, the true God,The One who formed the earth, its Maker who firmly established it, Who did not create it simply for nothing, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am Jehovah, and there is no one else.

18696.label: Isaiah 45:19
18696.text: I did not speak in a concealed place, in a land of darkness;I did not say to the offspring of Jacob,‘Seek me simply for nothing.’ I am Jehovah, who speaks what is righteous and declares what is upright.

18697.label: Isaiah 45:20
18697.text: Gather together and come. Approach together, you escapees from the nations. They know nothing, those who carry around carved imagesAnd pray to a god that cannot save them.

18698.label: Isaiah 45:21
18698.text: Make your report, present your case. Let them consult together in unity. Who foretold this long agoAnd declared it from times past? Is it not I, Jehovah? There is no other God but me;A righteous God and a Savior, there is none besides me.

18699.label: Isaiah 45:22
18699.text: Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth,For I am God, and there is no one else.

18700.label: Isaiah 45:23
18700.text: By myself I have sworn;The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness,And it will not return: To me every knee will bend,Every tongue will swear loyalty

18701.label: Isaiah 45:24
18701.text: And say, ‘Surely in Jehovah are true righteousness and strength. All those enraged against him will come before him in shame.

18702.label: Isaiah 45:25
18702.text: In Jehovah all the offspring of Israel will prove to be right, And in him they will make their boast.’”

18703.label: Isaiah 46:1
18703.text: Bel bends down, Neʹbo stoops over. Their idols are loaded on animals, on beasts of burden, Like baggage that burdens the weary animals.

18704.label: Isaiah 46:2
18704.text: They stoop and bend down together;They cannot rescue the loads, And they themselves go into captivity.

18705.label: Isaiah 46:3
18705.text: “Listen to me, O house of Jacob, and all you who remain of the house of Israel, You whom I have supported from birth and carried from the womb.

18706.label: Isaiah 46:4
18706.text: Until you grow old I will be the same; Until your hair is gray I will keep bearing you. As I have done, I will carry you and bear you and rescue you.

18707.label: Isaiah 46:5
18707.text: To whom will you liken me or make me equal or compare me, So that we should resemble each other?

18708.label: Isaiah 46:6
18708.text: There are those who lavish gold from their purse;They weigh out the silver on the scale. They hire a metalworker, and he makes it into a god. Then they prostrate themselves, yes, they worship it.

18709.label: Isaiah 46:7
18709.text: They lift it to their shoulders; They carry it and put it in its place, and it just stands there. It does not move from its place. They cry out to it, but it does not answer;It cannot rescue anyone from distress.

18710.label: Isaiah 46:8
18710.text: Remember this, and take courage. Take it to heart, you transgressors.

18711.label: Isaiah 46:9
18711.text: Remember the former things of long ago,That I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is no one like me.

18712.label: Isaiah 46:10
18712.text: From the beginning I foretell the outcome,And from long ago the things that have not yet been done. I say, ‘My decision will stand, And I will do whatever I please.’

18713.label: Isaiah 46:11
18713.text: I am calling a bird of prey from the sunrise, From a distant land the man to carry out my decision. I have spoken, and I will bring it about. I have purposed it, and I will also carry it out.

18714.label: Isaiah 46:12
18714.text: Listen to me, you who are stubborn of heart,You who are far away from righteousness.

18715.label: Isaiah 46:13
18715.text: I have brought my righteousness near;It is not far away,And my salvation will not delay. I will grant salvation in Zion, my splendor to Israel.”

18716.label: Isaiah 47:1
18716.text: Come down and sit in the dust,O virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit down on the ground where there is no throne, O daughter of the Chal·deʹans,For never again will people call you delicate and pampered.

18717.label: Isaiah 47:2
18717.text: Take a hand mill and grind flour. Remove your veil. Strip off your skirt, uncover your legs. Cross over the rivers.

18718.label: Isaiah 47:3
18718.text: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Your shame will be exposed. I will take vengeance, and no man will stand in my way.

18719.label: Isaiah 47:4
18719.text: “The One repurchasing us—Jehovah of armies is his name—Is the Holy One of Israel.”

18720.label: Isaiah 47:5
18720.text: Sit there silently and go into darkness,O daughter of the Chal·deʹans; No more will they call you Mistress of Kingdoms.

18721.label: Isaiah 47:6
18721.text: I grew indignant at my people. I profaned my inheritance, And I gave them into your hand. But you showed them no mercy. Even on the elderly you placed a heavy yoke.

18722.label: Isaiah 47:7
18722.text: You said: “I will always be the Mistress, forever.” You did not take these things to heart;You did not consider how the matter would end.

18723.label: Isaiah 47:8
18723.text: Now hear this, O lover of pleasure, Who sits in security, who says in her heart: “I am the one, and there is no one else. I will not become a widow. I will never know the loss of children.”

18724.label: Isaiah 47:9
18724.text: But these two things will come upon you suddenly, in one day: Loss of children and widowhood. In full measure they will come upon you Because of your many sorceries and all your powerful spells.

18725.label: Isaiah 47:10
18725.text: You trusted in your wickedness. You said: “No one sees me.” Your wisdom and knowledge are what led you astray,And you say in your heart: “I am the one, and there is no one else.”

18726.label: Isaiah 47:11
18726.text: But calamity will come upon you,And none of your charms will stop it. Adversity will befall you; you will not be able to avert it. Sudden ruin will come upon you like you have never known.

18727.label: Isaiah 47:12
18727.text: Go ahead, then, with your spells and your many sorceries, With which you have toiled from your youth. Perhaps you may be able to benefit;Perhaps you may strike people with awe.

18728.label: Isaiah 47:13
18728.text: You have grown weary with the multitude of your advisers. Let them stand up now and save you,Those who worship the heavens, who gaze at the stars, Those giving out knowledge at the new moonsAbout the things that will come upon you.

18729.label: Isaiah 47:14
18729.text: Look! They are like stubble. A fire will burn them up. They cannot save themselves from the power of the flame. These are not charcoals for keeping warm,And this is not a fire to sit in front of.

18730.label: Isaiah 47:15
18730.text: So your charmers will become to you,Those with whom you toiled from your youth. They will wander, each one in his own direction. There will be no one to save you.

18731.label: Isaiah 48:1
18731.text: Hear this, O house of Jacob,You who call yourselves by the name of Israel And who have come from the waters of Judah,You who swear by the name of Jehovah And who call on the God of Israel,Though not in truth and righteousness.

18732.label: Isaiah 48:2
18732.text: For they call themselves after the holy city And seek the support of the God of Israel, Whose name is Jehovah of armies.

18733.label: Isaiah 48:3
18733.text: “The former things I told you long ago. From my own mouth they went out,And I made them known. Suddenly I took action, and they came about.

18734.label: Isaiah 48:4
18734.text: Because I knew how stubborn you are—That your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead is copper —

18735.label: Isaiah 48:5
18735.text: I told you long ago. Before it came about, I caused you to hear it,So that you could not say, ‘My idol did this;My carved image and my metal image commanded this.’

18736.label: Isaiah 48:6
18736.text: You have heard and seen all of this. Will you not declare it? From now on I am announcing new things to you, Guarded secrets that you have not known.

18737.label: Isaiah 48:7
18737.text: Only now are they being created, and not long ago,Things that you never heard before today,So that you cannot say, ‘Look! I already know them.’

18738.label: Isaiah 48:8
18738.text: No, you have not heard, you have not known,And in the past your ears were not opened. For I know that you are very treacherous, And you have been called a transgressor from birth.

18739.label: Isaiah 48:9
18739.text: But for the sake of my name I will hold back my anger; For my own praise I will restrain myself toward you,And I will not do away with you.

18740.label: Isaiah 48:10
18740.text: Look! I have refined you, but not in the form of silver. I have tested you in the smelting furnace of affliction.

18741.label: Isaiah 48:11
18741.text: For my own sake, for my own sake I will act, For how could I let myself be profaned? I give my glory to no one else.

18742.label: Isaiah 48:12
18742.text: Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called. I am the same One. I am the first; I am also the last.

18743.label: Isaiah 48:13
18743.text: My own hand laid the foundation of the earth, And my right hand spread out the heavens. When I call to them, they stand up together.

18744.label: Isaiah 48:14
18744.text: Gather together, all of you, and listen. Who among them has announced these things? Jehovah has loved him. He will carry out his delight against Babylon, And his arm will come against the Chal·deʹans.

18745.label: Isaiah 48:15
18745.text: I myself have spoken, and I have called him. I have brought him, and his way will be successful.

18746.label: Isaiah 48:16
18746.text: Come near to me, and hear this. From the very start I have not spoken in secret. From the time it happened I was there.” And now the Sovereign Lord Jehovah has sent me, and his spirit.

18747.label: Isaiah 48:17
18747.text: This is what Jehovah says, your Repurchaser, the Holy One of Israel: “I, Jehovah, am your God,The One teaching you to benefit yourself, The One guiding you in the way you should walk.

18748.label: Isaiah 48:18
18748.text: If only you would pay attention to my commandments! Then your peace would become just like a river And your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

18749.label: Isaiah 48:19
18749.text: Your offspring would be as many as the sandAnd your descendants as its grains. Their name would never be cut off or annihilated from before me.”

18750.label: Isaiah 48:20
18750.text: Go out from Babylon! Flee from the Chal·deʹans! Announce it with a joyful cry! Proclaim it! Make it known to the ends of the earth. Say: “Jehovah has repurchased his servant Jacob.

18751.label: Isaiah 48:21
18751.text: They did not become thirsty when he led them through devastated places. He caused water to flow out of the rock for them;He split a rock and made water gush out.”

18752.label: Isaiah 48:22
18752.text: “There is no peace,” says Jehovah, “for the wicked.”

18753.label: Isaiah 49:1
18753.text: Listen to me, you islands,And pay attention, you faraway nations. Jehovah has called me before I was born. From the time I was in my mother’s womb he has made mention of my name.

18754.label: Isaiah 49:2
18754.text: He made my mouth like a sharp sword;He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He made me a polished arrow;He concealed me in his quiver.

18755.label: Isaiah 49:3
18755.text: He said to me: “You are my servant, O Israel, Through whom I will show my splendor.”

18756.label: Isaiah 49:4
18756.text: But I said: “I have toiled for nothing. I used up my strength for an unreality, in vain. But surely my judgment is with Jehovah, And my wages with my God.”

18757.label: Isaiah 49:5
18757.text: And now Jehovah, the One who formed me from the womb as his servant,Has said for me to bring Jacob back to him,So that Israel may be gathered to him. I will be glorified in the eyes of Jehovah,And my God will have become my strength.

18758.label: Isaiah 49:6
18758.text: And he said: “It is not enough that you are my servantTo raise up the tribes of JacobAnd to bring back those who were preserved of Israel. I have also given you as a light of nations, So that my salvation may reach the ends of the earth.”

18759.label: Isaiah 49:7
18759.text: This is what Jehovah, the Repurchaser of Israel, his Holy One, says to the one who is despised, to the one who is detested by the nation, to the servant of rulers: “Kings will see and rise up,And princes will bow downBecause of Jehovah, who is faithful, The Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

18760.label: Isaiah 49:8
18760.text: This is what Jehovah says: “In a time of favor I answered you, And in a day of salvation I helped you; I kept safeguarding you to give you as a covenant for the people, To rehabilitate the land,To cause them to possess their desolate inheritances,

18761.label: Isaiah 49:9
18761.text: To say to the prisoners, ‘Come out!’ And to those in the darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ By the roadways they will feed,Along all the worn paths will be their pastures.

18762.label: Isaiah 49:10
18762.text: They will not go hungry, nor will they thirst, Nor will scorching heat or the sun beat down on them. For the One who has mercy on them will lead them, And he will guide them by the springs of water.

18763.label: Isaiah 49:11
18763.text: I will make all my mountains into a road,And my highways will be raised up.

18764.label: Isaiah 49:12
18764.text: Look! These are coming from far away, And look! these from the north and from the west,And these from the land of Siʹnim.”

18765.label: Isaiah 49:13
18765.text: Shout for joy, you heavens, and rejoice, you earth. Let the mountains become cheerful with a joyful cry. For Jehovah has comforted his people, And he shows mercy to his own afflicted ones.

18766.label: Isaiah 49:14
18766.text: But Zion kept saying: “Jehovah has abandoned me, and Jehovah has forgotten me.”

18767.label: Isaiah 49:15
18767.text: Can a woman forget her nursing childOr have no compassion for the son of her womb? Even if these women forget, I would never forget you.

18768.label: Isaiah 49:16
18768.text: Look! On my palms I have engraved you. Your walls are always before me.

18769.label: Isaiah 49:17
18769.text: Your sons hurry back. Those who tore you down and devastated you will depart from you.

18770.label: Isaiah 49:18
18770.text: Raise your eyes and look all around. They are all gathering together. They are coming to you. “As surely as I am living,” declares Jehovah,“You will clothe yourself with all of them as with ornaments,And you will fasten them on yourself as a bride does.

18771.label: Isaiah 49:19
18771.text: Although your places were devastated and desolate and your land was in ruins, Now it will become too cramped for those dwelling there, And those who swallowed you down will be far away.

18772.label: Isaiah 49:20
18772.text: The sons born when you were bereaved will say in your hearing,‘This place is too cramped for me. Make room for me to dwell here.’

18773.label: Isaiah 49:21
18773.text: And you will say in your heart,‘Who has fathered these for me,Since I am a woman bereaved of children and barren,Exiled and taken prisoner? Who has raised these? Look! I was left all alone, So where have these come from?’”

18774.label: Isaiah 49:22
18774.text: This is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Look! I will raise up my hand to the nations,And I will lift up my signal to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms And carry your daughters on their shoulders.

18775.label: Isaiah 49:23
18775.text: Kings will become caretakers for you, And their princesses will be your nurses. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground And lick the dust of your feet, And you will have to know that I am Jehovah;Those hoping in me will not be put to shame.”

18776.label: Isaiah 49:24
18776.text: Can those already captured be taken from a mighty man,Or can the captives of the tyrant be rescued?

18777.label: Isaiah 49:25
18777.text: But this is what Jehovah says: “Even the captives of a mighty man will be taken away, And those captured by the tyrant will be rescued. I will oppose those who oppose you, And I will save your own sons.

18778.label: Isaiah 49:26
18778.text: I will make those who mistreat you eat their own flesh,And as with sweet wine, they will become drunk with their own blood. And all people will have to know that I am Jehovah, Your Savior and your Repurchaser, The Powerful One of Jacob.”

18779.label: Isaiah 50:1
18779.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Where is the divorce certificate of your mother, whom I sent away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Look! It was because of your own errors you were sold,And because of your own transgressions your mother was sent away.

18780.label: Isaiah 50:2
18780.text: Why, then, was no one here when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Is my hand too short to redeem,Or is there no power in me to rescue? Look! With my rebuke I dry up the sea; I make rivers a desert. Their fish rot for lack of water,And they die because of thirst.

18781.label: Isaiah 50:3
18781.text: I clothe the heavens with gloom, And I make sackcloth their covering.”

18782.label: Isaiah 50:4
18782.text: The Sovereign Lord Jehovah has given me the tongue of those taught, So that I may know how to answer the tired one with the right word. He awakens me morning by morning;He awakens my ear to listen like the taught ones.

18783.label: Isaiah 50:5
18783.text: The Sovereign Lord Jehovah has opened my ear,And I was not rebellious. I did not turn in the opposite direction.

18784.label: Isaiah 50:6
18784.text: I offered my back to those striking meAnd my cheeks to those who plucked them bare. I did not hide my face from humiliating things and from spit.

18785.label: Isaiah 50:7
18785.text: But the Sovereign Lord Jehovah will help me. That is why I will not feel humiliated. That is why I have set my face like a flint, And I know that I will not be put to shame.

18786.label: Isaiah 50:8
18786.text: The One who declares me righteous is near. Who can accuse me? Let us stand up together. Who has a case against me? Let him approach me.

18787.label: Isaiah 50:9
18787.text: Look! The Sovereign Lord Jehovah will help me. Who will pronounce me guilty? Look! They will all wear out like a garment. A moth will eat them up.

18788.label: Isaiah 50:10
18788.text: Who among you fears JehovahAnd listens to the voice of his servant? Who has walked in deep darkness, without any brightness? Let him trust in the name of Jehovah and support himself on his God.

18789.label: Isaiah 50:11
18789.text: “Look! All of you who are igniting a fire,Making sparks fly,Walk in the light of your fire,Among the sparks you have set ablaze. This is what you will have from my hand: In sheer pain you will lie down.

18790.label: Isaiah 51:1
18790.text: “Listen to me, you who are pursuing righteousness,You who are seeking Jehovah. Look to the rock from which you were hewnAnd to the quarry from which you were dug.

18791.label: Isaiah 51:2
18791.text: Look to Abraham your fatherAnd to Sarah who gave birth to you. For he was only one when I called him, And I blessed him and made him many.

18792.label: Isaiah 51:3
18792.text: For Jehovah will comfort Zion. He will bring comfort to all her ruins, And he will make her wilderness like Eʹden And her desert plain like the garden of Jehovah. Exultation and rejoicing will be found in her,Thanksgiving and melodious song.

18793.label: Isaiah 51:4
18793.text: Pay attention to me, O my people,And give ear to me, my nation. For a law will go out from me, And my justice I will establish as a light to the peoples.

18794.label: Isaiah 51:5
18794.text: My righteousness draws near. My salvation will go out, And my arms will judge the peoples. In me the islands will hope, And for my arm they will wait.

18795.label: Isaiah 51:6
18795.text: Raise your eyes to the heavens,And look at the earth below. For the heavens will disperse in fragments like smoke;The earth will wear out like a garment,And its inhabitants will die like gnats. But my salvation will be eternal, And my righteousness will never fail.

18796.label: Isaiah 51:7
18796.text: Listen to me, you who know righteousness,The people with my law in their heart. Do not be afraid of the taunts of mortal men,And do not be terrified because of their insults.

18797.label: Isaiah 51:8
18797.text: For a moth will eat them up just like a garment;The clothes moth will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever,And my salvation for all generations.”

18798.label: Isaiah 51:9
18798.text: Awake! Awake! Clothe yourself with strength,O arm of Jehovah! Awake as in the days of long ago, as in past generations. Was it not you who broke Raʹhab to pieces,Who pierced the sea monster?

18799.label: Isaiah 51:10
18799.text: Are you not the one who dried up the sea, the waters of the vast deep? The one who made the depths of the sea a roadway for the repurchased ones to cross?

18800.label: Isaiah 51:11
18800.text: The redeemed ones of Jehovah will return. They will come to Zion with a joyful cry, And unending joy will crown them. Exultation and rejoicing will be theirs,And grief and sighing will flee away.

18801.label: Isaiah 51:12
18801.text: “I myself am the One comforting you. Why should you be afraid of a mortal man who will die And of a son of man who will wither like green grass?

18802.label: Isaiah 51:13
18802.text: Why do you forget Jehovah your Maker, The One who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundation of the earth? And all day long you were in constant fear of the rage of the oppressor, As though he were in a position to bring you to ruin. Where, now, is the rage of the oppressor?

18803.label: Isaiah 51:14
18803.text: The one bent over in chains will soon be set free; He will not die and go into the pit,Nor will his bread be lacking.

18804.label: Isaiah 51:15
18804.text: But I am Jehovah your God,Who stirs up the sea and makes its waves boisterous —Jehovah of armies is his name.

18805.label: Isaiah 51:16
18805.text: I will put my words in your mouth,And with the shadow of my hand I will cover you, In order to plant the heavens and to lay the foundation of the earth And to say to Zion, ‘You are my people.’

18806.label: Isaiah 51:17
18806.text: Awake! Awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, You who have drunk from the hand of Jehovah his cup of wrath. You have drunk the goblet;You have drained out the cup causing staggering.

18807.label: Isaiah 51:18
18807.text: Not one of all the sons whom she bore is there to guide her,And not one of all the sons whom she raised has taken hold of her hand.

18808.label: Isaiah 51:19
18808.text: These two things have befallen you. Who will sympathize with you? Destruction and devastation, hunger and sword! Who will comfort you?

18809.label: Isaiah 51:20
18809.text: Your sons have fainted. They lie down at every street corner Like wild sheep in the net. They are full of the wrath of Jehovah, the rebuke of your God.”

18810.label: Isaiah 51:21
18810.text: So please listen to this,O woman afflicted and drunk, though not with wine.

18811.label: Isaiah 51:22
18811.text: This is what your Lord Jehovah says, your God who defends his people: “Look! I will take from your hand the cup causing staggering, The goblet, my cup of wrath;You will never drink it again.

18812.label: Isaiah 51:23
18812.text: I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, Those who said to you, ‘Bow down so that we may walk over you!’ So you made your back like the ground,Like a street for them to walk on.”

18813.label: Isaiah 52:1
18813.text: Awake! Awake! Clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city! For no more will the uncircumcised and unclean one enter into you.

18814.label: Isaiah 52:2
18814.text: Shake off the dust, rise and take a seat, O Jerusalem. Loosen the bonds on your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

18815.label: Isaiah 52:3
18815.text: For this is what Jehovah says: “You were sold for nothing, And without money you will be repurchased.”

18816.label: Isaiah 52:4
18816.text: For this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “At first my people went down to Egypt to live there as foreigners; Then As·syrʹi·a oppressed them without cause.”

18817.label: Isaiah 52:5
18817.text: “What, then, should I do here?” declares Jehovah. “For my people were taken for nothing. Those ruling over them keep howling in triumph,” declares Jehovah,“And constantly, all day long, my name is treated with disrespect.

18818.label: Isaiah 52:6
18818.text: For that reason my people will know my name; For that reason they will know in that day that I am the One speaking. Look, it is I!”

18819.label: Isaiah 52:7
18819.text: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of the one bringing good news, The one proclaiming peace, The one bringing good news of something better,The one proclaiming salvation,The one saying to Zion: “Your God has become King!”

18820.label: Isaiah 52:8
18820.text: Listen! Your watchmen raise their voice. In unison they shout joyfully,For they will see it clearly when Jehovah gathers back Zion.

18821.label: Isaiah 52:9
18821.text: Become cheerful, shout joyfully in unison, you ruins of Jerusalem, For Jehovah has comforted his people; he has repurchased Jerusalem.

18822.label: Isaiah 52:10
18822.text: Jehovah has bared his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations; All the ends of the earth will see the acts of salvation of our God.

18823.label: Isaiah 52:11
18823.text: Turn away, turn away, get out of there, touch nothing unclean! Get out from the midst of her, keep yourselves clean,You who are carrying the utensils of Jehovah.

18824.label: Isaiah 52:12
18824.text: For you will not depart in panic,Nor will you have to flee,For Jehovah will go ahead of you, And the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

18825.label: Isaiah 52:13
18825.text: Look! My servant will act with insight. He will be raised up high,He will be elevated and greatly exalted.

18826.label: Isaiah 52:14
18826.text: Just as there were many who stared at him in amazement—For his appearance was disfigured more than that of any other manAnd his stately form more than that of mankind—

18827.label: Isaiah 52:15
18827.text: So he will startle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths before him, Because they will see what they had not been toldAnd give consideration to what they had not heard.

18828.label: Isaiah 53:1
18828.text: Who has put faith in the thing heard from us? And as for the arm of Jehovah, to whom has it been revealed?

18829.label: Isaiah 53:2
18829.text: He will come up like a twig before him, like a root out of parched land. No stately form does he have, nor any splendor; And when we see him, his appearance does not draw us to him.

18830.label: Isaiah 53:3
18830.text: He was despised and was avoided by men, A man who was meant for pains and was familiar with sickness. It was as if his face were hidden from us. He was despised, and we held him as of no account.

18831.label: Isaiah 53:4
18831.text: Truly he himself carried our sicknesses, And he bore our pains. But we considered him as plagued, stricken by God and afflicted.

18832.label: Isaiah 53:5
18832.text: But he was pierced for our transgression; He was crushed for our errors. He bore the punishment for our peace, And because of his wounds we were healed.

18833.label: Isaiah 53:6
18833.text: Like sheep we have all wandered about, Each has turned his own way,And Jehovah has caused the error of us all to meet up with him.

18834.label: Isaiah 53:7
18834.text: He was oppressed and he let himself be afflicted, But he would not open his mouth. He was brought like a sheep to the slaughter, Like a ewe that is silent before its shearers,And he would not open his mouth.

18835.label: Isaiah 53:8
18835.text: Because of restraint and judgment he was taken away;And who will concern himself with the details of his generation? For he was cut off from the land of the living; Because of the transgression of my people he received the stroke.

18836.label: Isaiah 53:9
18836.text: And he was given a burial place with the wicked, And with the rich in his death, Although he had done no wrong And there was no deception in his mouth.

18837.label: Isaiah 53:10
18837.text: But it was Jehovah’s will to crush him, and he let him become sick. If you will present his life as a guilt offering, He will see his offspring, he will prolong his days, And through him the delight of Jehovah will have success.

18838.label: Isaiah 53:11
18838.text: Because of his anguish, he will see and be satisfied. By means of his knowledge the righteous one, my servant, Will bring a righteous standing to many people, And their errors he will bear.

18839.label: Isaiah 53:12
18839.text: For that reason I will assign him a portion among the many,And he will apportion the spoil with the mighty,Because he poured out his life even to death And was counted among the transgressors; He carried the sin of many people, And he interceded for the transgressors.

18840.label: Isaiah 54:1
18840.text: “Shout joyfully, you barren woman who has not given birth! Become cheerful and cry out for joy, you who never had birth pains, For the sons of the desolate one are more numerousThan the sons of the woman with a husband,” says Jehovah.

18841.label: Isaiah 54:2
18841.text: “Make the place of your tent more spacious. Stretch out the tent cloths of your grand tabernacle. Do not hold back, lengthen your tent cords,And make your tent pins strong.

18842.label: Isaiah 54:3
18842.text: For you will spread out to the right and to the left. Your offspring will take possession of nations,And they will inhabit the desolated cities.

18843.label: Isaiah 54:4
18843.text: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; And do not feel humiliated, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth,And the disgrace of your widowhood you will remember no more.”

18844.label: Isaiah 54:5
18844.text: “For your Grand Maker is as your husband, Jehovah of armies is his name,And the Holy One of Israel is your Repurchaser. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

18845.label: Isaiah 54:6
18845.text: For Jehovah called you as if you were an abandoned wife and grief-stricken, Like a wife married in youth and then rejected,” says your God.

18846.label: Isaiah 54:7
18846.text: “For a brief moment I abandoned you,But with great mercy I will gather you back.

18847.label: Isaiah 54:8
18847.text: In a flood of indignation I hid my face from you for a moment, But with everlasting loyal love I will have mercy on you,” says your Repurchaser, Jehovah.

18848.label: Isaiah 54:9
18848.text: “This is like the days of Noah to me. Just as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more cover the earth, So I swear that I will no more become indignant toward you or rebuke you.

18849.label: Isaiah 54:10
18849.text: For the mountains may be removedAnd the hills may be shaken,But my loyal love will not be removed from you, Nor will my covenant of peace be shaken,” says Jehovah, the One having mercy on you.

18850.label: Isaiah 54:11
18850.text: “O afflicted woman, storm-tossed, uncomforted, I am laying your stones with hard mortarAnd your foundation with sapphires.

18851.label: Isaiah 54:12
18851.text: I will make your battlements of rubies,Your gates of sparkling stones, And all your boundaries of precious stones.

18852.label: Isaiah 54:13
18852.text: And all your sons will be taught by Jehovah, And the peace of your sons will be abundant.

18853.label: Isaiah 54:14
18853.text: You will be firmly established in righteousness. You will be far removed from oppression, You will fear nothing and have no cause for terror,For it will not come near you.

18854.label: Isaiah 54:15
18854.text: If anyone should attack you,It will not be at my orders. Whoever makes an attack on you will fall because of you.”

18855.label: Isaiah 54:16
18855.text: “Look! I myself created the craftsman,Who blows on the charcoal fire,And his work produces a weapon. I myself also created the destructive man to bring ruin.

18856.label: Isaiah 54:17
18856.text: No weapon formed against you will have any success, And you will condemn any tongue that rises up against you in the judgment. This is the heritage of the servants of Jehovah,And their righteousness is from me,” declares Jehovah.

18857.label: Isaiah 55:1
18857.text: Come, all you thirsty ones, come to the water! You with no money, come, buy and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

18858.label: Isaiah 55:2
18858.text: Why do you keep paying out money for what is not bread,And why spend your earnings for what brings no satisfaction? Listen intently to me, and eat what is good, And you will find great delight in what is truly rich.

18859.label: Isaiah 55:3
18859.text: Incline your ear and come to me. Listen, and you will keep alive,And I will readily make with you an everlasting covenant In harmony with the expressions of loyal love to David, which are faithful.

18860.label: Isaiah 55:4
18860.text: Look! I made him a witness to the nations,A leader and commander to the nations.

18861.label: Isaiah 55:5
18861.text: Look! You will call a nation that you do not know,And those of a nation who have not known you will run to youFor the sake of Jehovah your God, the Holy One of Israel,Because he will glorify you.

18862.label: Isaiah 55:6
18862.text: Search for Jehovah while he may be found. Call to him while he is near.

18863.label: Isaiah 55:7
18863.text: Let the wicked man leave his way And the evil man his thoughts;Let him return to Jehovah, who will have mercy on him, To our God, for he will forgive in a large way.

18864.label: Isaiah 55:8
18864.text: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, And your ways are not my ways,” declares Jehovah.

18865.label: Isaiah 55:9
18865.text: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth,So my ways are higher than your waysAnd my thoughts than your thoughts.

18866.label: Isaiah 55:10
18866.text: For just as the rain and the snow pour down from heavenAnd do not return there until they saturate the earth, making it produce and sprout,Giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater,

18867.label: Isaiah 55:11
18867.text: So my word that goes out of my mouth will be. It will not return to me without results, But it will certainly accomplish whatever is my delight, And it will have sure success in what I send it to do.

18868.label: Isaiah 55:12
18868.text: For you will go out with rejoicing, And in peace you will be brought back. The mountains and the hills will become cheerful before you with a joyful cry, And the trees of the field will all clap their hands.

18869.label: Isaiah 55:13
18869.text: Instead of thornbushes the juniper tree will grow, And instead of the stinging nettle the myrtle tree will grow. And it will bring fame to Jehovah, An everlasting sign that will never perish.”

18870.label: Isaiah 56:1
18870.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Uphold justice, and do what is righteous,For my salvation will soon comeAnd my righteousness will be revealed.

18871.label: Isaiah 56:2
18871.text: Happy is the man who does thisAnd the son of man who holds fast to it,Who keeps the Sabbath and does not profane it And who holds his hand back from any kind of evil.

18872.label: Isaiah 56:3
18872.text: The foreigner who joins himself to Jehovah should not say,‘Jehovah will surely separate me from his people.’ And the eunuch should not say, ‘Look! I am a dried-up tree.’”

18873.label: Isaiah 56:4
18873.text: For this is what Jehovah says to the eunuchs who keep my sabbaths and who choose what I delight in and who hold fast to my covenant:

18874.label: Isaiah 56:5
18874.text: “I will give to them in my house and within my walls a monument and a name,Something better than sons and daughters. An everlasting name I will give them,One that will not perish.

18875.label: Isaiah 56:6
18875.text: As for the foreigners who join themselves to Jehovah to minister to him,To love the name of Jehovah And to be his servants,All those who keep the Sabbath and do not profane itAnd who hold fast to my covenant,

18876.label: Isaiah 56:7
18876.text: I will also bring them to my holy mountain And make them rejoice inside my house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar. For my house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples.”

18877.label: Isaiah 56:8
18877.text: The Sovereign Lord Jehovah, who is gathering the dispersed ones of Israel, declares: “I will gather to him others besides those already gathered.”

18878.label: Isaiah 56:9
18878.text: All you wild animals of the field, come to eat,All you wild animals in the forest.

18879.label: Isaiah 56:10
18879.text: His watchmen are blind, none of them have taken note. All of them are speechless dogs, unable to bark. They are panting and lying down; they love to slumber.

18880.label: Isaiah 56:11
18880.text: They are dogs with a voracious appetite; They are never satisfied. They are shepherds who have no understanding. They have all gone their own way;Every last one of them seeks his own dishonest gain and says:

18881.label: Isaiah 56:12
18881.text: “Come, let me take some wine,And let us drink our fill of alcohol. And tomorrow will be like today, only far better!”

18882.label: Isaiah 57:1
18882.text: The righteous one has perished,But no one takes it to heart. Loyal men are taken away, With no one discerning that the righteous one has been taken awayBecause of the calamity.

18883.label: Isaiah 57:2
18883.text: He enters into peace. They rest on their beds, all who walk uprightly.

18884.label: Isaiah 57:3
18884.text: “But as for you, come closer,You sons of a sorceress,You children of an adulterer and a prostitute:

18885.label: Isaiah 57:4
18885.text: Whom are you making fun of? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not the children of transgression,The children of deceit,

18886.label: Isaiah 57:5
18886.text: Those who are inflamed with passion among big trees, Under every luxuriant tree, Who slaughter the children in the valleys, Under the clefts of the crags?

18887.label: Isaiah 57:6
18887.text: With the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. Yes, these are your lot. Even to them you pour out drink offerings and offer gifts. Should I be satisfied with these things?

18888.label: Isaiah 57:7
18888.text: On a mountain high and lofty you prepared your bed, And you went up there to offer sacrifice.

18889.label: Isaiah 57:8
18889.text: Behind the door and the doorpost you set up your memorial. You left me and uncovered yourself;You went up and made your bed spacious. And you made a covenant with them. You loved sharing their bed, And you gazed at the male organ.

18890.label: Isaiah 57:9
18890.text: You went down to Melʹech with oilAnd with an abundance of perfume. You sent your envoys far off,So that you descended to the Grave.

18891.label: Isaiah 57:10
18891.text: You have toiled in following your many ways,But you did not say, ‘It is hopeless!’ You found renewed strength. That is why you do not give up.

18892.label: Isaiah 57:11
18892.text: Whom did you dread and fearSo that you started to lie? You did not remember me. You took nothing to heart. Have I not kept silent and withdrawn? So you showed no fear of me.

18893.label: Isaiah 57:12
18893.text: I will make known your ‘righteousness’ and your works, And they will not benefit you.

18894.label: Isaiah 57:13
18894.text: When you cry for help,Your collection of idols will not rescue you. A wind will carry all of them away,A mere breath will blow them away,But the one who takes refuge in me will inherit the landAnd will take possession of my holy mountain.

18895.label: Isaiah 57:14
18895.text: It will be said, ‘Build up, build up a road! Prepare the way! Remove any obstacle from the way of my people.’”

18896.label: Isaiah 57:15
18896.text: For this is what the High and Lofty One says,Who lives forever and whose name is holy: “I reside in the high and holy place, But also with those crushed and lowly in spirit,To revive the spirit of the lowlyAnd to revive the heart of those being crushed.

18897.label: Isaiah 57:16
18897.text: For I will not oppose them foreverOr always remain indignant; For a man’s spirit would grow feeble because of me, Even the breathing creatures that I have made.

18898.label: Isaiah 57:17
18898.text: I was indignant at his sinful pursuit of dishonest gain, So I struck him, I hid my face, and I was indignant. But he kept walking as a renegade, following the way of his heart.

18899.label: Isaiah 57:18
18899.text: I have seen his ways,But I will heal him and lead him And restore comfort to him and to his mourning ones.”

18900.label: Isaiah 57:19
18900.text: “I am creating the fruit of the lips. Continuous peace will be given to the one who is far away and the one who is near,” says Jehovah,“And I will heal him.”

18901.label: Isaiah 57:20
18901.text: “But the wicked are like the restless sea that cannot calm down,And its waters keep tossing up seaweed and mire.

18902.label: Isaiah 57:21
18902.text: There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”

18903.label: Isaiah 58:1
18903.text: “Call out full-throated; do not hold back! Raise your voice like a horn. Proclaim to my people their revolt, To the house of Jacob their sins.

18904.label: Isaiah 58:2
18904.text: They seek me day after day,And they express delight to know my ways,As if they were a nation that had practiced righteousnessAnd had not abandoned the justice of their God. They ask me for righteous judgments,Delighting to draw close to God:

18905.label: Isaiah 58:3
18905.text: ‘Why do you not see when we fast? And why do you not notice when we afflict ourselves?’ Because on the day of your fast, you pursue your own interests, And you oppress your laborers.

18906.label: Isaiah 58:4
18906.text: Your fasting ends in quarrels and fights,And you strike with the fist of wickedness. You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice heard in heaven.

18907.label: Isaiah 58:5
18907.text: Should the fast that I choose be like this,As a day for someone to afflict himself, To bow down his head like a rush,To make his bed on sackcloth and ashes? Is this what you call a fast and a day pleasing to Jehovah?

18908.label: Isaiah 58:6
18908.text: No, this is the fast that I choose: To remove the fetters of wickedness,To untie the bands of the yoke bar, To let the oppressed go free, And to break in half every yoke bar;

18909.label: Isaiah 58:7
18909.text: It is to share your bread with the hungry, To bring the poor and homeless into your house,To clothe someone naked when you see him, And not to turn your back on your own flesh.

18910.label: Isaiah 58:8
18910.text: Then your light will shine through like the dawn, And your healing will spring up quickly. Your righteousness will go before you,And the glory of Jehovah will be your rear guard.

18911.label: Isaiah 58:9
18911.text: Then you will call, and Jehovah will answer;You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am!’ If you remove from among you the yoke barAnd stop pointing your finger and speaking maliciously,

18912.label: Isaiah 58:10
18912.text: If you grant to the hungry what you yourself desire And satisfy those who are afflicted, Then your light will shine even in the darkness,And your gloom will be like midday.

18913.label: Isaiah 58:11
18913.text: Jehovah will always lead youAnd satisfy you even in a parched land; He will invigorate your bones,And you will become like a well-watered garden, Like a spring whose waters never fail.

18914.label: Isaiah 58:12
18914.text: They will rebuild ancient ruins on your account, And you will restore the foundations of past generations. You will be called the repairer of the broken walls, The restorer of roadways by which to dwell.

18915.label: Isaiah 58:13
18915.text: If because of the Sabbath you refrain from pursuing your own interests on my holy day And you call the Sabbath an exquisite delight, a holy day of Jehovah, a day to be glorified, And you glorify it rather than pursuing your own interests and speaking idle words,

18916.label: Isaiah 58:14
18916.text: Then you will find your exquisite delight in Jehovah,And I will make you ride on the high places of the earth. I will cause you to eat from the inheritance of Jacob your forefather, For the mouth of Jehovah has spoken.”

18917.label: Isaiah 59:1
18917.text: Look! The hand of Jehovah is not too short to save, Nor is his ear too dull to hear.

18918.label: Isaiah 59:2
18918.text: No, your own errors have separated you from your God. Your sins have made him hide his face from you,And he refuses to hear you.

18919.label: Isaiah 59:3
18919.text: For your palms are polluted with blood And your fingers with error. Your lips speak lies, and your tongue mutters unrighteousness.

18920.label: Isaiah 59:4
18920.text: No one calls out for righteousness, And no one goes to court in truthfulness. They trust in unreality and speak what is worthless. They conceive trouble and give birth to what is harmful.

18921.label: Isaiah 59:5
18921.text: They hatch the eggs of a poisonous snake,And they weave the cobweb of a spider. Anyone who eats their eggs would die,And the egg that is crushed hatches a viper.

18922.label: Isaiah 59:6
18922.text: Their cobweb will not serve as a garment,Nor will they cover themselves with what they make. Their works are harmful,And deeds of violence are in their hands.

18923.label: Isaiah 59:7
18923.text: Their feet run to do evil,And they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are harmful thoughts;Ruin and misery are in their ways.

18924.label: Isaiah 59:8
18924.text: They have not known the way of peace,And there is no justice in their tracks. They make their roadways crooked;No one treading on them will know peace.

18925.label: Isaiah 59:9
18925.text: That is why justice is far away from us,And righteousness does not overtake us. We keep hoping for light, but look! there is darkness;For brightness, but we keep walking in gloom.

18926.label: Isaiah 59:10
18926.text: We grope for the wall like blind men;Like those without eyes we keep groping. We stumble at high noon as in evening darkness;Among the strong we are just like the dead.

18927.label: Isaiah 59:11
18927.text: We all keep growling like bearsAnd cooing mournfully like doves. We hope for justice, but there is none;For salvation, but it is far away from us.

18928.label: Isaiah 59:12
18928.text: For our revolts are many before you; Each of our sins testifies against us. For our revolts are with us;We well know our errors.

18929.label: Isaiah 59:13
18929.text: We have transgressed and denied Jehovah;We have turned our backs on our God. We have spoken of oppression and revolt; We have conceived lies and muttered false words from the heart.

18930.label: Isaiah 59:14
18930.text: Justice is driven back, And righteousness stands far off; For truth has stumbled in the public square,And what is upright is unable to enter.

18931.label: Isaiah 59:15
18931.text: Truth has vanished, And anyone who turns away from bad is plundered. Jehovah saw this and was displeased, For there was no justice.

18932.label: Isaiah 59:16
18932.text: He saw that there was no man,And he was astonished that no one interceded,So his own arm brought about salvation, And his own righteousness supported him.

18933.label: Isaiah 59:17
18933.text: Then he put on righteousness like a coat of mailAnd the helmet of salvation on his head. He put on the garments of vengeance as his clothing And wrapped himself with zeal like a coat.

18934.label: Isaiah 59:18
18934.text: He will reward them for what they have done: Wrath to his adversaries, retribution to his enemies. And to the islands he will repay their due.

18935.label: Isaiah 59:19
18935.text: From the sunset they will fear the name of JehovahAnd from the sunrise his glory,For he will come in like a rushing river,Which the spirit of Jehovah drives along.

18936.label: Isaiah 59:20
18936.text: “To Zion the Repurchaser will come, To those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares Jehovah.

18937.label: Isaiah 59:21
18937.text: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Jehovah. “My spirit that is on you and my words that I have placed in your mouth—they will not be removed from your mouth, from the mouth of your children, or from the mouth of your grandchildren,” says Jehovah, “from now on and forever.”

18938.label: Isaiah 60:1
18938.text: “Arise, O woman, shed light, for your light has come. The glory of Jehovah shines on you.

18939.label: Isaiah 60:2
18939.text: For look! darkness will cover the earthAnd thick gloom the nations;But on you Jehovah will shine,And on you his glory will be seen.

18940.label: Isaiah 60:3
18940.text: Nations will go to your light And kings to your shining splendor.

18941.label: Isaiah 60:4
18941.text: Raise your eyes and look all around you! They have all been assembled; they are coming to you. From far away your sons keep coming, And your daughters being supported on the hip.

18942.label: Isaiah 60:5
18942.text: At that time you will see and become radiant, And your heart will throb and overflow,Because the wealth of the sea will be directed to you;The resources of the nations will come to you.

18943.label: Isaiah 60:6
18943.text: Throngs of camels will cover your land, Young male camels of Midʹi·an and Eʹphah. All those from Sheʹba—they will come;Gold and frankincense they will carry. They will proclaim the praises of Jehovah.

18944.label: Isaiah 60:7
18944.text: All the flocks of Keʹdar will be gathered to you. The rams of Ne·baʹioth will serve you. They will come on my altar with approval, And I will beautify my glorious house.

18945.label: Isaiah 60:8
18945.text: Who are these that fly along like clouds,Like doves to their dovecotes?

18946.label: Isaiah 60:9
18946.text: For in me the islands will hope; The ships of Tarʹshish are in the lead, To bring your sons from far away, Along with their silver and their gold,To the name of Jehovah your God and to the Holy One of Israel,For he will glorify you.

18947.label: Isaiah 60:10
18947.text: Foreigners will build your walls,And their kings will minister to you, For in my indignation I struck you,But in my favor I will have mercy on you.

18948.label: Isaiah 60:11
18948.text: Your gates will be kept open constantly; They will not be closed by day or by night,To bring to you the resources of the nations,And their kings will take the lead.

18949.label: Isaiah 60:12
18949.text: For any nation and any kingdom that will not serve you will perish,And the nations will be utterly devastated.

18950.label: Isaiah 60:13
18950.text: To you the glory of Lebʹa·non will come, The juniper tree, the ash tree, and the cypress together, To beautify the place of my sanctuary;I will glorify the place for my feet.

18951.label: Isaiah 60:14
18951.text: The sons of those who oppressed you will come and bow down before you;All those treating you disrespectfully must bow down at your feet,And they will have to call you the city of Jehovah,Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

18952.label: Isaiah 60:15
18952.text: Instead of your being abandoned and hated, with nobody passing through, I will make you a source of everlasting pride,A cause for rejoicing throughout all generations.

18953.label: Isaiah 60:16
18953.text: And you will actually drink the milk of nations, At the breast of kings you will nurse; And you will certainly know that I, Jehovah, am your Savior,And the Powerful One of Jacob is your Repurchaser.

18954.label: Isaiah 60:17
18954.text: Instead of the copper I will bring in gold,And instead of the iron I will bring in silver,Instead of the wood, copper,And instead of the stones, iron;And I will appoint peace as your overseersAnd righteousness as your task assigners.

18955.label: Isaiah 60:18
18955.text: No more will violence be heard in your landOr destruction and ruin within your boundaries. And you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

18956.label: Isaiah 60:19
18956.text: For you the sun will no longer be a light by day,Nor will the shining of the moon give you light,For Jehovah will become to you an eternal light, And your God will be your beauty.

18957.label: Isaiah 60:20
18957.text: No more will your sun set,Nor will your moon wane,For Jehovah will become for you an eternal light, And the days of your mourning will have ended.

18958.label: Isaiah 60:21
18958.text: And all your people will be righteous;They will possess the land forever. They are the sprout that I planted,The work of my hands, for me to be beautified.

18959.label: Isaiah 60:22
18959.text: The little one will become a thousandAnd the small one a mighty nation. I myself, Jehovah, will speed it up in its own time.”

18960.label: Isaiah 61:1
18960.text: The spirit of the Sovereign Lord Jehovah is upon me, Because Jehovah anointed me to declare good news to the meek. He sent me to bind up the brokenhearted,To proclaim liberty to the captivesAnd the wide opening of the eyes to the prisoners,

18961.label: Isaiah 61:2
18961.text: To proclaim the year of Jehovah’s goodwill And the day of vengeance of our God, To comfort all who mourn,

18962.label: Isaiah 61:3
18962.text: To provide for those mourning over Zion,To give them a headdress instead of ashes,The oil of exultation instead of mourning,The garment of praise instead of a despondent spirit. And they will be called big trees of righteousness,The planting of Jehovah, in order to glorify him.

18963.label: Isaiah 61:4
18963.text: They will rebuild the ancient ruins;They will raise up the desolated places of the past, And they will restore the devastated cities, The places that lay desolate for generation after generation.

18964.label: Isaiah 61:5
18964.text: “Strangers will stand and shepherd your flocks,And foreigners will be your farmers and your vinedressers.

18965.label: Isaiah 61:6
18965.text: As for you, you will be called the priests of Jehovah; They will call you the ministers of our God. You will eat the resources of the nations, And about their glory you will boast.

18966.label: Isaiah 61:7
18966.text: Instead of shame you will have a double portion,And instead of humiliation they will shout joyfully over their share. Yes, they will possess a double portion in their land. Everlasting rejoicing will be theirs.

18967.label: Isaiah 61:8
18967.text: For I, Jehovah, love justice; I hate robbery and unrighteousness. I will faithfully give them their wages,And I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

18968.label: Isaiah 61:9
18968.text: Their offspring will be known among the nations And their descendants among the peoples. All who see them will recognize them,That they are the offspring whom Jehovah has blessed.”

18969.label: Isaiah 61:10
18969.text: I will greatly exult in Jehovah. My whole being will rejoice in my God. For he has clothed me with the garments of salvation; He has wrapped me with the robe of righteousness,Just like a bridegroom who wears a turban like that of a priest, And like a bride who adorns herself with her ornaments.

18970.label: Isaiah 61:11
18970.text: For as the earth brings forth its sproutsAnd as the garden makes what is sown in it sprout,So will the Sovereign Lord JehovahCause righteousness and praise to sprout before all the nations.

18971.label: Isaiah 62:1
18971.text: For the sake of Zion I will not keep silent, And for the sake of Jerusalem I will not keep stillUntil her righteousness shines like a bright light And her salvation burns like a torch.

18972.label: Isaiah 62:2
18972.text: “The nations will see your righteousness, O woman, And all kings your glory. And you will be called by a new name, Which Jehovah’s own mouth will designate.

18973.label: Isaiah 62:3
18973.text: You will become a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah,A royal turban in the palm of your God.

18974.label: Isaiah 62:4
18974.text: No more will you be called an abandoned woman, And your land will no longer be called desolate. But you will be called My Delight Is in Her, And your land will be called the Married One. For Jehovah will take delight in you,And your land will be as one married.

18975.label: Isaiah 62:5
18975.text: For just as a young man marries a virgin,Your sons will marry you. With the rejoicing of a bridegroom over a bride,Your God will rejoice over you.

18976.label: Isaiah 62:6
18976.text: Upon your walls, O Jerusalem, I have commissioned watchmen. Continuously, all day long and all night long, they should not be silent. You who make mention of Jehovah,Do not rest,

18977.label: Isaiah 62:7
18977.text: And do not give him any rest until he firmly establishes Jerusalem,Yes, until he makes her the praise of the earth.”

18978.label: Isaiah 62:8
18978.text: Jehovah has sworn an oath with his right hand, with his strong arm: “I will no longer give your grain as food to your enemies,Nor will foreigners drink your new wine, for which you have toiled.

18979.label: Isaiah 62:9
18979.text: But those gathering it will eat it and they will praise Jehovah;And those collecting it will drink it in my holy courtyards.”

18980.label: Isaiah 62:10
18980.text: Pass through, pass through the gates. Clear the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway. Rid it of stones. Raise up a signal for the peoples.

18981.label: Isaiah 62:11
18981.text: Look! Jehovah has proclaimed to the ends of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion,‘Look! Your salvation is coming. Look! His reward is with him,And the wage he pays is before him.’”

18982.label: Isaiah 62:12
18982.text: They will be called the holy people, those repurchased by Jehovah, And you will be called Sought After, a City Not Abandoned.

18983.label: Isaiah 63:1
18983.text: Who is this coming from Eʹdom, From Bozʹrah with bright-colored garments,This one with splendid clothing,Marching in his great power? “It is I, the One speaking in righteousness,The One with great power to save.”

18984.label: Isaiah 63:2
18984.text: Why is your clothing red,And why are your garments like those of one treading the winepress?

18985.label: Isaiah 63:3
18985.text: “I have trodden the wine trough alone. No one from the peoples was with me. I kept treading them in my anger,And I kept trampling them in my wrath. My garments were spattered with their blood,And I have stained all my clothing.

18986.label: Isaiah 63:4
18986.text: For the day of vengeance is in my heart, And the year of my repurchased ones has come.

18987.label: Isaiah 63:5
18987.text: I looked, but there was no one to help;I was appalled that no one offered support. So my arm brought me salvation, And my own wrath supported me.

18988.label: Isaiah 63:6
18988.text: I trampled peoples in my anger,I made them drunk with my wrath And poured out their blood on the ground.”

18989.label: Isaiah 63:7
18989.text: I will mention Jehovah’s acts of loyal love,The praiseworthy acts of Jehovah,Because of all that Jehovah has done for us, The many good things he has done for the house of Israel,According to his mercy and his great loyal love.

18990.label: Isaiah 63:8
18990.text: For he said: “Surely they are my people, sons who will not be disloyal.” So he became their Savior.

18991.label: Isaiah 63:9
18991.text: During all their distress it was distressing to him. And his own personal messenger saved them. In his love and compassion he repurchased them, And he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

18992.label: Isaiah 63:10
18992.text: But they rebelled and grieved his holy spirit. He then turned into their enemy, And he fought against them.

18993.label: Isaiah 63:11
18993.text: And they remembered the days of old,The days of Moses his servant: “Where is the One who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is the One who put within him His holy spirit,

18994.label: Isaiah 63:12
18994.text: The One who made His glorious arm go with the right hand of Moses, The One who split the waters before them To make an everlasting name for himself,

18995.label: Isaiah 63:13
18995.text: The One who made them walk through the surging waters, So that they walked without stumbling,Like a horse in the open country?

18996.label: Isaiah 63:14
18996.text: Just like livestock when they go down into the valley plain,The spirit of Jehovah made them rest.” This is how you led your people,To make a majestic name for yourself.

18997.label: Isaiah 63:15
18997.text: Look down from heaven and seeFrom your lofty abode of holiness and glory. Where are your zeal and your mightiness,The stirring of your compassions and your mercy? They are withheld from me.

18998.label: Isaiah 63:16
18998.text: For you are our Father; Although Abraham may not know usAnd Israel may not recognize us,You, O Jehovah, are our Father. Our Repurchaser of long ago is your name.

18999.label: Isaiah 63:17
18999.text: Why do you, O Jehovah, let us wander from your ways? Why do you let our hearts become hard, so that we do not fear you? Return, for the sake of your servants,The tribes of your inheritance.

19000.label: Isaiah 63:18
19000.text: Your holy people possessed it for a short time. Our adversaries have trampled on your sanctuary.

19001.label: Isaiah 63:19
19001.text: For too long we have become like those you never ruled over,Like those never called by your name.

19002.label: Isaiah 64:1
19002.text: If only you had ripped the heavens apart and come down,So that the mountains would quake because of you,

19003.label: Isaiah 64:2
19003.text: As when a fire ignites the brushwood,And the fire makes the water boil,Then your name would be known to your adversaries,And the nations would tremble before you!

19004.label: Isaiah 64:3
19004.text: When you did awe-inspiring things that we dared not hope for, You came down, and the mountains quaked before you.

19005.label: Isaiah 64:4
19005.text: From of old no one has heard or given ear,Nor has any eye seen a God except you,Who acts in behalf of those who keep in expectation of him.

19006.label: Isaiah 64:5
19006.text: You have met up with those who joyfully do what is right, Those who remember you and follow your ways. Look! You became indignant, while we kept sinning, We did so for a long time. Should we now be saved?

19007.label: Isaiah 64:6
19007.text: And we have all become like someone unclean,And all our acts of righteousness are like a menstrual cloth. We will all wither like a leaf,And our errors will carry us off like the wind.

19008.label: Isaiah 64:7
19008.text: There is no one calling on your name,No one who stirs himself to take hold of you,For you have hidden your face from us, And you cause us to waste away because of our error.

19009.label: Isaiah 64:8
19009.text: But now, O Jehovah, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you are our Potter; We are all the work of your hand.

19010.label: Isaiah 64:9
19010.text: Do not become too indignant, O Jehovah, And do not remember our error forever. Look at us, please, for we are all your people.

19011.label: Isaiah 64:10
19011.text: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness,Jerusalem a wasteland.

19012.label: Isaiah 64:11
19012.text: Our house of holiness and glory, Where our forefathers praised you,Has been burned with fire, And all the things we cherished lie in ruins.

19013.label: Isaiah 64:12
19013.text: In view of this, will you still restrain yourself, O Jehovah? Will you remain silent and let us be afflicted so severely?

19014.label: Isaiah 65:1
19014.text: “I have let myself be searched for by those who did not ask for me;I have let myself be found by those who did not look for me. I said, ‘Here I am, here I am!’ to a nation that was not calling on my name.

19015.label: Isaiah 65:2
19015.text: I have spread out my hands all day long to a stubborn people, To those walking in the way that is not good, Following their own thoughts;

19016.label: Isaiah 65:3
19016.text: A people who constantly offend me to my face, Sacrificing in gardens and making sacrificial smoke on bricks.

19017.label: Isaiah 65:4
19017.text: They sit among graves, And they pass the night in hidden places, Eating the flesh of pigs, And the broth of foul things is in their vessels.

19018.label: Isaiah 65:5
19018.text: They say, ‘Keep to yourself; do not approach me,For I am holier than you.’ These are a smoke in my nostrils, a fire burning all day long.

19019.label: Isaiah 65:6
19019.text: Look! It is written before me;I will not stand still,But I will repay them, I will repay them in full measure

19020.label: Isaiah 65:7
19020.text: For their errors and for the errors of their forefathers as well,” says Jehovah. “Because they have made sacrificial smoke on the mountainsAnd have reproached me on the hills, I will first measure out their wages in full.”

19021.label: Isaiah 65:8
19021.text: This is what Jehovah says: “Just as when new wine is found in a cluster of grapesAnd someone says, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is some good in it,’ So I will do for the sake of my servants;I will not destroy them all.

19022.label: Isaiah 65:9
19022.text: I will bring out of Jacob an offspring And out of Judah the one to inherit my mountains; My chosen ones will take possession of it,And my servants will reside there.

19023.label: Isaiah 65:10
19023.text: Sharʹon will become a pasture for sheepAnd the Valley of Aʹchor a resting-place for cattle,For my people who search for me.

19024.label: Isaiah 65:11
19024.text: But you are among those forsaking Jehovah, Those forgetting my holy mountain, Those setting a table for the god of Good Luck,And those filling up cups of mixed wine for the god of Destiny.

19025.label: Isaiah 65:12
19025.text: So I will destine you for the sword, And all of you will bow down to be slaughtered, Because I called, but you did not answer,I spoke, but you did not listen; You kept doing what was bad in my eyes,And you chose what displeased me.”

19026.label: Isaiah 65:13
19026.text: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord Jehovah says: “Look! My servants will eat, but you will go hungry. Look! My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty. Look! My servants will rejoice, but you will suffer shame.

19027.label: Isaiah 65:14
19027.text: Look! My servants will shout joyfully because of the good condition of the heart,But you will cry out because of the pain of heartAnd you will wail because of a broken spirit.

19028.label: Isaiah 65:15
19028.text: You will leave behind a name that my chosen ones will use as a curse,And the Sovereign Lord Jehovah will put each of you to death,But his own servants he will call by another name;

19029.label: Isaiah 65:16
19029.text: So that anyone who seeks a blessing for himself in the earthWill be blessed by the God of truth, And anyone who swears an oath in the earthWill swear by the God of truth. For the former distresses will be forgotten;They will be concealed from my eyes.

19030.label: Isaiah 65:17
19030.text: For look! I am creating new heavens and a new earth; And the former things will not be called to mind, Nor will they come up into the heart.

19031.label: Isaiah 65:18
19031.text: So exult and be joyful forever in what I am creating. For look! I am creating Jerusalem a cause for joyAnd her people a cause for exultation.

19032.label: Isaiah 65:19
19032.text: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem and exult in my people; No more will there be heard in her the sound of weeping or a cry of distress.”

19033.label: Isaiah 65:20
19033.text: “No more will there be an infant from that place who lives but a few days,Nor an old man who fails to live out his days. For anyone who dies at a hundred will be considered a mere boy,And the sinner will be cursed, even though he is a hundred years of age.

19034.label: Isaiah 65:21
19034.text: They will build houses and live in them, And they will plant vineyards and eat their fruitage.

19035.label: Isaiah 65:22
19035.text: They will not build for someone else to inhabit,Nor will they plant for others to eat. For the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, And the work of their hands my chosen ones will enjoy to the full.

19036.label: Isaiah 65:23
19036.text: They will not toil for nothing, Nor will they bear children for distress,Because they are the offspring made up of those blessed by Jehovah, And their descendants with them.

19037.label: Isaiah 65:24
19037.text: Even before they call out, I will answer;While they are yet speaking, I will hear.

19038.label: Isaiah 65:25
19038.text: The wolf and the lamb will feed together,The lion will eat straw just like the bull, And the serpent’s food will be dust. They will do no harm nor cause any ruin in all my holy mountain,” says Jehovah.

19039.label: Isaiah 66:1
19039.text: This is what Jehovah says: “The heavens are my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Where, then, is the house that you could build for me, And where is my resting-place?”

19040.label: Isaiah 66:2
19040.text: “My own hand has made all these things,And this is how they all came to be,” declares Jehovah. “To this one, then, I will look,To the one humble and broken in spirit who trembles at my word.

19041.label: Isaiah 66:3
